Tulina okukwata ku kwesittala kwaffe, tufube okutegeera ‘ebiwundu’ byaffe, era tukozese emisingi gya Baibuli okufuna okuwona, okuzzibwa obuggya, n’okutabagana. Bw’oba ng’ofumitiddwa, nsuubira nti ekitundu kino eky’ekitabo kijja kukuyamba okutuuka mu kifo eky’obulamu obutuukiridde mu Kristo, ng’omanyi nga Dawudi bwe yamanya, nti “Akomyawo emmeeme yange” (Zabbuli 23:3), era nti abo “Omwana b’afuula ab’eddembe, babeerera ddala ba ddembe” (Yokaana 8:36). Endiga Eyeesittadde Mmwe abawi b’amagezi, abakadde b’ekkanisa, oba abasumba, mbakuutira nti buno bwe buweereza bwammwe. Ekitundu ky’Ebyawandiikibwa ekinsomooza ennyo nga ndi musumba era omuwi w’amagezi kiri mu Matayo 18. Essuula eno yonna ekwata ku kwesittala, okuzzibwa obuggya, okutabagana, n’okusonyiwa. Ekinsomooza ennyo ye ngeri Matayo gy’awandiikamu olugero olw’omusumba n’endiga ekikumi, awagamba nti, “Omuntu bw’aba n’endiga ze ekikumi, emu n’emubulako, taleka ziri ekyenda mu omwenda ku lusozi n’agenda anoonya eri emu ebuze? Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, bw’agiraba agisanyukira nnyo okusinga ziri ekyenda mu omwenda ezitaabuze” (Matayo 18:12-14). Eyava mu kisibo ndiga, si mbuzi. Mu Ndagaano Empya, abakkiriza batera okuyitibwa “endiga,” ate ekigambo “embuzi” kikozesebwa ku abo abatakkiriza. Ekifaananyi kino kya mukkiriza eyeesittadde, n’afuluma mu kkanisa, oboolyawo ng’alina obutwa obutono obweteguse okusaasaanira ku buli anaawuliriza. Ffenna kino kitutuukako mu bibiina byaffe, era emirundi mingi tukemebwa okukuba mu ngalo nga tugamba nti, “Kirungi agenze! Yali musajja munakuwavu nnyo!” Mu kifo ky’ekyo, tukubirizibwa okugoberera endiga eyo, nga tufuba okugitegeera n’okugiweereza awatali kugisalira musango, nga twesiga nti Mukama ajja kuleeta okutabagana n’okuzzibwa obuggya. Singa tukikola, oboolyawo twandibadde n’abasajja ‘abanakuwavu’ abatono nnyo mu kkanisa yaffe! Oluusi endiga eva ng’efumitiddwa ekiwundu ekinene. Nzijukira omuwala omu eyajja gye ndi, ng’alumizibbwa nnyo kubanga abakulembeze b’‘obuweereza’ bwe baali bamubonerezza, nga bafunye alipoota embi ezimukwatako; naye nga tewali n’omu ayagala kumubuulira alipoota ezo kye zaali zoogera. Nagenda okulaba abakulembeze be, omulamuzi we omukulu n’aŋŋamba nti baali “bamulese abonerere yekka mu ebyo bye yeereetedde, ayigire ekyokuyiga.” Nagamba omukulembeze oyo, eyali yeeyita omusumba, nti tetuweereddwa lukusa kukwata ndiga mu ngeri eyo. “Endiga bw’ekwatibwa mu kisaka eky’amaggwa, nteekwa okwewalula ne nnyingira okugisumulula, ne bwe nnaasalibwako amaggwa era oboolyawo ne nnumwa endiga eno erumizibbwa. Olwo ne nfukamu amafuta n’omwenge, ne nsiba ebiwundu, ne ndyoka nteera endiga eddembe nga ngikuutira obutaddayo mu kisaka kya maggwa. Bwe mpulira okukaaba nate, ne ndaba endiga mu kisaka ekirala oluvannyuma lw’akaseera katono, nzira mu ngeri y’emu. Kino kigenda mu maaso n’okukuutira okulala era oboolyawo n’okukozesa omuguwa, naye siyinza n’akatono kuyimirira ebweru w’ekisaka, nnyweze olunwe nga ŋŋamba nti, ‘Kikusaanidde! Bonerera wekka mu ebyo bye weereetedde!’ Omusumba Omukulu teyampa lukusa lwa ngeri eyo bwe yampita okuweereza ng’omusumba omubeezi!” Omuwala oyo yagobebwa mu buweereza obwo, wadde nga nnali nnyonnyodde bulungi abakulembeze be nti alipoota ezaali zimulumiriza zaasinziira ku bulimba! Tekyewuunyisa nti yali afumitiddwa ekiwundu ekinene bw’ekyo era ng’alina okuweebwa obuwi bw’amagezi obw’ekikugu okumala ebbanga eddene!

fields.title: Ekisumuluzo ky’Eddembe
fields.body_html:
Ekitundu ekinene eky’obuwi bw’amagezi bwe nkola kwe kuyamba abantu okukwata ku kwesittala kwabwe. Essaawa mmeka ze twandiwonyezza singa baali bamanyi obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe obw’obuntu, ne bakola ng’emisingi gya Baibuli bwe gigamba!

Ndowooza nti emu ku nkwe enkulu omulabe z’akozesa okutuziyiza mu lutalo, gwe muwendo omunene ogw’essaawa abasumba ze bamala (naddala mu Bukiika kkono bwa Amerika), nga bakwata ku nsonga z’obuwi bw’amagezi abakkiriza ze bandisobodde okwekwatirako bo bennyini singa baali banyiikira okusoma Ekigambo.

Omulimu gw’omusumba gwandibadde kumalawo obwetaavu bw’obuwi bw’amagezi obusinga obungi mu bantu be, ng’abayigiriza emisingi gya Baibuli. Gwe mulimu gwe, ng’omusumba, okubatwala mu ‘ddundiro ly’omuddo omuto’ endiga gye zeeriira zokka; naye tutuuse mu kifo endiga we zikyetaagira okuliisibwa mu ccupa (okuweebwa amagezi), buli lwe wabaawo ‘akatyabaga!’ Setaani abbye ekkanisa abasumba baayo bangi ng’abazitoowerera n’‘obwetaavu’ bw’obuwi bw’amagezi.

Ekifaananyi eky’obutonde kiri nti, bwe tulya obulungi ne tuduka bulungi, tunaasigala nga tuli balamu bulungi; naye buli omu ategeera nti wajja kubaawo ebiseera, oba olw’akabenje oba olw’obulwadde obutakoma, omuntu mw’ayetaagira obuyambi bw’omulala. Wabaawo ebiwundu ebibi ate n’omulwadde ng’alemadde mu ngeri emu, okusaasirwa, okubudaabudwa, n’obuyambi bw’omulala biba bya muwendo. Ne ku biwundu eby’omwoyo bwe kiri bwe kityo.

Waliwo ebitabo bingi eby’Ekikristaayo ku katale ebikwata ku biwundu eby’emmeeme. Byogera ku ‘kuwonya ebijjukizo’ eby’amaka agatali malamu n’obwesigamye obw’obulabe. Bingi ku byo birungi nnyo era biwadde obuyambi bungi abantu abanoonya endowooza empya ku bulamu ne ku bo bennyini. Enteekateeka ey’‘emitendera 12’ eya Alcoholics Anonymous efuuse omusingi gw’okuyigiriza kuno okusinga obungi, ng’ekigendererwa kwe kutuusa omuntu afumitiddwa mu kifo eky’okwekuuma. Olwo basobola okukwata ku kizibu kyabwe mu ngeri ennuŋŋamu, nga bakozesa ebibiina eby’obuyambi, obuwi bw’amagezi obutasalako, n’enteekateeka eziragiddwa oba ‘ekipimo’ eky’ebikolwa. Buli lunaku, baba n’ekiragiro eky’‘okutambuza’ okuwona kwabwe. Nkozesezza ebitabo bino era nkyabikozesa ku kitundu. Ekinneeraliikiriza ku bingi ku byo kiri nti bitono nnyo ebyogera ku maanyi g’okusonyiwa agateera eddembe .

Sikkiriza nti ekigendererwa kya Mukama kwe kutuusa abantu be abafumitiddwa mu ‘kwekuuma,’ wabula ayagala okuzza emmeeme zaabwe obuggya, n’okubaleetera okuwona. Ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’ekitabo kino kwe kuyigiriza engeri gye tuyinza okusumululwa okuva mu busibe bw’ebiwundu byaffe, tulyoke tube ab’omugaso ennyo mu lutalo eri omulabe waffe, Setaani. Ekisumuluzo eky’okuwona kisangibwa mu kusonyiwa.

Ebisumuluzo by’Obwakabaka → Matayo 16:19

Okumala emyaka esatu abayigirizwa baali batambudde ne Mukama nga bayita mu bitundu bya Buyudaaya, Samaliya, ne Ggaliraaya. Baali balabye ng’akola ebyamagero bingi era nga bawulidde ng’ayigiriza ebibiina, naye yali atera obutatuula wansi kwogera nabo bokka. Kaakano, oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’emirimu mingi, abatwala mu bukiika kkono ewala ennyo ow’ensi, mu bitundu ebyetoolodde Kayisaliya ekya Firipo, ku njegoyego z’olusozi Herumooni. Bwe baali batambula, omusomesa n’akyukira abayigirizwa be n’ababuuza ebibuuzo bibiri.

Ekibuuzo ekisooka kikwata ku ndowooza y’abantu ku Yesu, ate ekibuuzo ekiddako kikwata ku ndowooza y’abayigirizwa ku Yesu.

Abayigirizwa bwe baamala okuddamu ekibuuzo ekisooka, n’addamu okubakyukira, n’ababuuza nti, “Mmwe mundowooza kuba ani?” (Matayo 16:15). Baali batuuse okutegeera nti Yesu yali asinga okuba omusajja omulungi oba omukozi w’ebyamagero?

Simooni Peetero n’addamu nti, “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Yesu n’amugamba nti, “Olina omukisa Simooni, omwana wa Yona, kubanga ekyo Kitange ali mu ggulu y’akikubikkulidde, so tokiggye mu bantu. Era nkutegeeza nti, Ggwe Peetero, olwazi, era ku lwazi okwo kwe ndizimba Ekkanisa yange, n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula. Era ndikuwa ebisumuluzo by’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu; era kyonna ky’onoosibanga ku nsi, ne mu ggulu kinaasibwanga, na buli ky’onoosumululanga ku nsi, ne mu ggulu kinaasumululwanga” (Matayo 16:16-19).

Okumala ebyasa bingi, Ekkanisa Enkatuliki ey’e Rooma yayigiriza nti kino kye kiragiro ekyaweebwa bapaapa bonna, nga basikira Peetero, omukulu w’ekkanisa, okugoba mu kkanisa bakabaka, amawanga, n’abantu abatawagira biragiro byabwe, oba okugaba obusonyiyo.

Tekyandibadde kya kitalo singa wabeera n’ekisumuluzo eky’obwakabaka ku lw’abo b’oyagala? Ku lwa munno gw’ofumbiriganwa naye? Ku lw’omwana wo atalokoka? Ku lwa bazadde bo? Singa osobola okubaggulirawo ekkubo ery’obulamu obutaggwaawo! Kale, nzikiriza nti tulina obusobozi obwo!

Kya mazima nti bangi bakuumibwa wala n’essanyu ery’okulaba n’okuyingira mu bwakabaka olw’okulemererwa kwaffe okuba abajulirwa be twandibadde. Ekitundu ekinene eky’okulemererwa okwo kiri mu mitima gyaffe egitasonyiwa. Waliwo bazadde bangi leero abasaba, nga bakaaba, ku lw’omwana waabwe eyawaba, nga tebategeera nti obutasonyiwa bwe balina ku mwana oyo bwe buziyiza okusinga byonna Katonda okuddamu essaala!

Yesu yali ategeeza ki mu kitundu ekisembayo eky’olunyiriri lwaggulu? Mpeereddwa ennyinyonnyola nnyingi, okuva ku ‘buyinza’ bwa bapaapa, okutuuka ku ‘kununulibwa mu badayimooni,’ naye siraba na kimu ku ebyo wano.

Kya nkola nnungi ey’okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa, bw’oba otunuulira olunyiriri olutategeerekeka bulungi, okunoonya ennyiriri ezifaanagana, naddala ezaava mu mwandiisi omu. Mu mbeera eno, tetulina kugenda wala nnyo, kubanga oluvannyuma lw’essuula bbiri zokka, Matayo addamu okukiwandiika.

“Ddala ddala mbagamba nti byonna bye mulisiba ku nsi, ne mu ggulu birisibwa ne bye mulisumulula ku nsi, ne mu ggulu bigenda kusumululwa” (Matayo 18:18).

Ku mulundi guno Mukama ayogera n’abayigirizwa bonna, si Peetero yekka. Obanga ebisumuluzo byaweebwa okusumulula n’okusiba (nga bwe bikozesebwa bulijjo ebisumuluzo!), kale byaweebwa abayigirizwa bonna — nga mw’otwalidde nange naawe!

Omusingi ogwokubiri ogw’okunnyonnyola obulungi Ebyawandiikibwa kwe kwekenneenya ebigambo ebikwetoolodde; kale tujja kutunuulira Mukama kye yali ayigiriza mu kitundu ekisigadde ekya Matayo 18. Amangu ago tulaba nti essuula yonna ekwata ku kuzzibwa obuggya, okutabagana, n’okusonyiwa. Ebifaananyi ebitonotono byogera ku kuba ng’abaana, abatalina bukuusa era abatakwata bukyayi — abakkiriza ng’abo tebeesittaza balala wadde okubafumita; era naffe tusaana twegendereze obutabaleetera kwesittala oba biwundu.

Ekyokubiri kye ndaba kiri nti omuntu bw’afumitibwa oba n’alumizibwa, n’olwekyo n’agenda, omusumba omulungi ajja kuleka abalala n’azza ‘endiga’ eyo mu kisibo. Weetegereze nate nti olugero lwogera ku ‘ndiga’ so si ku ‘mbuzi.’ Lwogera ku bakkiriza, so si ku ‘babuze.’ Emirundi mingi, ‘omuntu ow’ekizibu’ bw’ava mu kkanisa, tukuba mu ngalo nga tugamba nti, “Kirungi agenze!” Katonda ky’asaba abasumba abaweereza, n’endiga endala, kwe kunoonya okuzzibwa kwabwe obuggya, so si okubagoba mu kussakimu.

“Muganda wo bw’akusobyanga ogendanga gy’ali,” nga musooka okubeera mwekka na ye, n’ekigendererwa kimu — okunoonya okutegeeragana n’okutabagana (Matayo 18:15). Weetegereze ekigambo “okusobya . ” Emirundi mingi ennyo tugenda nga twesittadde, ekiviirako okwesittala okusingako obunene. Tetuweereddwa kiragiro kya ngeri eyo kya kugenda gye bali nga twesittadde — wabula nga batusobezzaako. Ekyawukanako kyokka kyandibadde nga omusumba w’ekkanisa oba abakadde bwe bawulira nga kyetaagisa okusemberera omuntu gwe balowooza nti bulijjo y’aleeta okwesittala, oba asobezza ku balala. Mu mbeera eyo, ekigendererwa eky’okumusemberera bulijjo kiba kya kutabagana.

Yesu bw’aba ng’awa okuyigiriza okwa Matayo 18:18-20, ekibuuzo kijja eri Peetero ng’abuuza Mukama emirundi emeka gy’asaanidde okusonyiwa. “Emirundi musanvu?” (Matayo 18:22). Peetero oboolyawo yalowooza nti ekibuuzo kye kyandibadde kirungi, naye Mukama n’akikozesa okussa essira nti okusonyiwa tekulina kkomo.

Okwagala kutulagira okusonyiwanga bulijjo.

Essuula 18 yonna ekwata ku kuzzibwa obuggya, okutabagana, n’okusonyiwa, byonna nga tolese kwesittala ku bubwo… kye kigambo ekikulu eky’ekitabo kino!

Yokaana 20:23

Olunyiriri luno lwe lulala olufaanagana n’ennyiriri ebbiri ezaggulu, wadde nga lwawandiikibwa Yokaana mu Yokaana 20:23.

Mu lunyiriri luno, abayigirizwa bonna bali mu kisenge ekisibiddwa kubanga batya nti abakulembeze b’Abayudaaya bajja kujja mangu okubatwala, nga bwe baatwala Mukama waabwe. Enneewulira zaabwe ziri waggulu nnyo, era abamu abaaliwo baagamba nti baali balabye Mukama, ng’azuukidde mu bafu! Olugero lwali lubuna nti Yesu yali alabikidde Peetero ne Maliyamu Magudaleene awamu n’abalala babiri ku kkubo ery’e Emawu. Abalala tebandikkirizza okuggyako nga nabo balabye Mukama azuukidde.

Amangu ago, wadde ng’enzigi zaali nsibe, Yesu n’ayimirira wakati mu bo! N’agamba nti, “Emirembe gibe mu mmwe. Nga Kitange bwe yantuma, nange bwe mbatuma mmwe… Mufune Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Yokaana 20:21-22).

Ekiseera ky’Oluyonaani eky’ekigambo “mufune,” kye kiragiro ekiyitibwa ‘aorist imperative’ ekyetaagisa bulijjo okwanukula amangu ago. Mu kaseera ako, abayigirizwa baafuna obulamu bwabwe obuggya mu Mwoyo. Oluvannyuma, ku lunaku lwa Pentekoote, bandifunye okujjula kwe okubawa amaanyi ag’okuweereza. Baali baweereddwa obuyinza obuggya! “Buli muntu gwe munaasonyiwanga ebibi bye anaabanga asonyiyiddwa. Abo be munaagaananga okusonyiwa, banaabanga tebasonyiyiddwa” (Yokaana 20:23). Kkirizaayo nkinnyonnyole mu bugazi, “Abo be musumulula (be muteera eddembe) basumululwa; abo be musiba, basibwa.”

“Ani ayinza okusonyiwa ebibi okuggyako Katonda?” (Makko 2:7) Abafalisaayo bwe baabuuza. Mu ngeri emu, baali batuufu kubanga ekiragiro Mukama kye yatuwa ‘tekisonyiwa’ bibi mu kigero kye kimu ng’okusonyiwa kwe. Ye bw’asonyiwa, kiba nga “Ebibi byaffe abituggyako n’abitwala wala ng’ebuvanjuba bw’eri ewala okuva ebugwanjuba,” okutuuka mu buziba bw’ennyanja, nga tebiddayo kujjukirwa nate (Zabbuli 103:12) . Nze naawe tetusobola kukola ekyo — ku bibi byaffe ffe, so nga si ku by’omulala yenna. Ebibi byokka bye tusobola ‘okusonyiwa’ bye biri ebyakolebwa ku ffe — ebibi ebiyinza okuba nga bye byaleeta ebiwundu eby’emmeeme bye twetisse, Setaani mw’ayitidde okutuziyiza.

Okuggyawo Ekiziyiza eky’Ekibi

Bwe nkusobyako, mba nsobezza ne ku Katonda. Amangu ago, ekiziyiza kijja wakati wange ne Mukama wange. Nsanga nga kizibu okusaba, Ekigambo ne kifiirwa okunsikiriza, era n’okussakimu ne kutaba kuwoomerevu — ekibi kyange kifuuse ekire waggulu w’omutwe gwange!

Waliwo engeri bbiri ‘ekire’ ekyo mwe kiyinza okuggyibwawo.

Ey’olubereberye kwe “kwatula ekibi kyange, [kubanga] Ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okunsonyiwa ekibi kyange n’okunnaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna!” (1 Yokaana 1:9). Aleruya! Nkisanze nga ekisuubizo ekyo kya mazima.

Naye era nkizudde nti Mukama alina ‘omuze’ guno omutono ogw’okwogera nange ku kibi ekyo. Ng’amaze okunsonyiwa, n’alyoka awuguuma mu mmeeme yange nti, “Kaakano, genda eri muganda wo alyoke akusonyiwe. Sireetedde kukunaazaako kibi kyokka, naye njagala okukulaba ng’otabagana.” Ekikulu eri Ye si kusonyiwa — kwe kutabagana! Okwatula tekutuukiridde okuggyako nga kuleese okutabagana. Ekyo si buvunaanyizibwa bwe — bwange, kubanga “Kristo yatukomyawo eri Katonda era ne tuweebwa obuweereza obw’okutabaganya” (2 Abakkolinso 5:18-19).

Engeri ey’okubiri ‘ekire’ kyange mwe kiyinza okuggyibwawo, eggulu ne liddamu okunzigulirwa, kwe kuba nti ggwe okiggyawo ng’onsonyiye. Enkyusa ya Baibuli eya King James ekozesa ekigambo eky’enjawulo mu kuvvuunula Yokaana 20:23, awagamba nti, “Buli gw’oliggyako ebibi bye…” Ekigambo “okuggyako” kyogera ku ‘kuteeka ku bbali.’ Osobola okuggyawo ekibi kyange, ekyakolebwa ku ggwe, era mu kukola ekyo, n’onziguliriza eggulu. Bw’oteeka ekibi kyange ‘ku bbali,’ oggyawo ‘ekire,’ n’ekkubo ne liba ggule Kitaffe okwogera nange nga bwe kyali bwe nnasaba okusonyiyibwa kwe ku lwange. Ajja kuddamu okukwata ku mutima gwange, aleete okutabagana kwaffe!

Oyinza okusalawo okunsonyiwa kubanga omanyi nti Ebyawandiikibwa bikilagira, naye kyetaagisa nnyo, bwe tuba tugenda okutabagana, nti era onsumulule okuva mu musango gwa Katonda ogunneetisse, ng’onoonya okuteeka ku bbali ‘ekire’ eky’ekibi ekiri waggulu wange.

Bulijjo njogera ku “kusonyiwa n’okuteera eddembe” — biteekwa okubuulirwa awamu! Ekyokulabirako ekirungi kyandibadde Suteefano, omujulizi eyasooka okufa. Yali yaakalondebwa okuba omukulembeze mu kkanisa esooka, abakulembeze b’Abayudaaya bwe baamutwala ne bamukuba amayinja n’afa. Sawulo ow’e Taluso yali ayimiridde awo, ng’akkiriziganya nnyo n’ebikolwa byabwe, kubanga yali akyawa nnyo abagoberezi ba Yesu bano.

Suteefano bwe yali afa, n’akaaba mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Mukama wange, tobavunaana olw’ekibi kino!” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:60). Teyasabira ku bubwe buvumu, maanyi, wadde n’okuteebwa eddembe, wabula yabateera eddembe okuva mu musango gwabwe.

Neebuuza, Sawulo yandifuuse omutume omukulu Pawulo, singa Suteefano teyasaba ssaala eyo? Nzikiriza nti ye yaggulirawo Sawulo eggulu! Ne Yesu yasaba essaala efaanagana bwe yakaaba nti, “Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga kye bakola tebakimanyi” (Lukka 23:34), bwe yali afiirira nze naawe.

Ekivaamu ekimu eky’ekitalo eky’okuteera abalala eddembe kiri nti naffe tuteebwa eddembe! Kiri ng’okuba n’embalaasi ku nkomerero y’omuguwa — twandigambye nti embalaasi esibiddwa ng’etwetooloola mu ddundiro; naye embalaasi bw’esalawo okudduka n’eyita ku ttale ery’ettosi, tugenda kuwalulwa mu ttosi okuggyako nga tuleka omuguwa!

Ekifundikwa ky’owulira mu lubuto lwo ng’omuntu akusobezzaako, kiri ng’omuguwa ogwo. Osibiddwa mu nneewulira eri abo abakulumya . Obulumi obwo kitundu ku kiwundu kye baaleeta. Wadde ng’obasonyiye, ekifundikwa kiba wo buli lw’obasisinkana oba ng’owulira omuntu ng’ayogera ku bo.

Ggwe, era nabo, mwetaaga okuteebwa eddembe!

Yesu Wakati mu Bo

Kya nnaku engeri Matayo 18:18-20 gy’ajulizibwamu emirundi mingi ng’aggyibbwa mu bigambo ebimwetoolodde! Ennyiriri zino zoogera ku kusonyiwa, okuteera eddembe, n’okutabagana; si ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda ng’abantu bangi bakuŋŋaanye! Ebisuubizo bya Yesu ebiweereddwa awo, bya abo abanoonya n’obunyiikivu okutabagana.

“Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe” (Matayo 18:19-20). Essira erissibwa wano si ku kubeerawo kwe, kubanga bulijjo ali ne buli omu ku ffe abakkiriza, wabula ku mukisa gwe ogw’okutabagana — kye kintu ky’asinga okussa mu maaso!

Tuweereddwa ekisumuluzo ekijja okuggulirawo abalala eggulu era ekijja okututeera eddembe okuva mu biwundu, n’obusibe bwe baaleeta mu mmeeme zaffe! Ka tuyige okukozesa ekisumuluzo ekyo!
fields.body_text: Ekitundu ekinene eky’obuwi bw’amagezi bwe nkola kwe kuyamba abantu okukwata ku kwesittala kwabwe. Essaawa mmeka ze twandiwonyezza singa baali bamanyi obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe obw’obuntu, ne bakola ng’emisingi gya Baibuli bwe gigamba! Ndowooza nti emu ku nkwe enkulu omulabe z’akozesa okutuziyiza mu lutalo, gwe muwendo omunene ogw’essaawa abasumba ze bamala (naddala mu Bukiika kkono bwa Amerika), nga bakwata ku nsonga z’obuwi bw’amagezi abakkiriza ze bandisobodde okwekwatirako bo bennyini singa baali banyiikira okusoma Ekigambo. Omulimu gw’omusumba gwandibadde kumalawo obwetaavu bw’obuwi bw’amagezi obusinga obungi mu bantu be, ng’abayigiriza emisingi gya Baibuli. Gwe mulimu gwe, ng’omusumba, okubatwala mu ‘ddundiro ly’omuddo omuto’ endiga gye zeeriira zokka; naye tutuuse mu kifo endiga we zikyetaagira okuliisibwa mu ccupa (okuweebwa amagezi), buli lwe wabaawo ‘akatyabaga!’ Setaani abbye ekkanisa abasumba baayo bangi ng’abazitoowerera n’‘obwetaavu’ bw’obuwi bw’amagezi. Ekifaananyi eky’obutonde kiri nti, bwe tulya obulungi ne tuduka bulungi, tunaasigala nga tuli balamu bulungi; naye buli omu ategeera nti wajja kubaawo ebiseera, oba olw’akabenje oba olw’obulwadde obutakoma, omuntu mw’ayetaagira obuyambi bw’omulala. Wabaawo ebiwundu ebibi ate n’omulwadde ng’alemadde mu ngeri emu, okusaasirwa, okubudaabudwa, n’obuyambi bw’omulala biba bya muwendo. Ne ku biwundu eby’omwoyo bwe kiri bwe kityo. Waliwo ebitabo bingi eby’Ekikristaayo ku katale ebikwata ku biwundu eby’emmeeme. Byogera ku ‘kuwonya ebijjukizo’ eby’amaka agatali malamu n’obwesigamye obw’obulabe. Bingi ku byo birungi nnyo era biwadde obuyambi bungi abantu abanoonya endowooza empya ku bulamu ne ku bo bennyini. Enteekateeka ey’‘emitendera 12’ eya Alcoholics Anonymous efuuse omusingi gw’okuyigiriza kuno okusinga obungi, ng’ekigendererwa kwe kutuusa omuntu afumitiddwa mu kifo eky’okwekuuma. Olwo basobola okukwata ku kizibu kyabwe mu ngeri ennuŋŋamu, nga bakozesa ebibiina eby’obuyambi, obuwi bw’amagezi obutasalako, n’enteekateeka eziragiddwa oba ‘ekipimo’ eky’ebikolwa. Buli lunaku, baba n’ekiragiro eky’‘okutambuza’ okuwona kwabwe. Nkozesezza ebitabo bino era nkyabikozesa ku kitundu. Ekinneeraliikiriza ku bingi ku byo kiri nti bitono nnyo ebyogera ku maanyi g’okusonyiwa agateera eddembe . Sikkiriza nti ekigendererwa kya Mukama kwe kutuusa abantu be abafumitiddwa mu ‘kwekuuma,’ wabula ayagala okuzza emmeeme zaabwe obuggya, n’okubaleetera okuwona. Ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’ekitabo kino kwe kuyigiriza engeri gye tuyinza okusumululwa okuva mu busibe bw’ebiwundu byaffe, tulyoke tube ab’omugaso ennyo mu lutalo eri omulabe waffe, Setaani. Ekisumuluzo eky’okuwona kisangibwa mu kusonyiwa. Ebisumuluzo by’Obwakabaka → Matayo 16:19 Okumala emyaka esatu abayigirizwa baali batambudde ne Mukama nga bayita mu bitundu bya Buyudaaya, Samaliya, ne Ggaliraaya. Baali balabye ng’akola ebyamagero bingi era nga bawulidde ng’ayigiriza ebibiina, naye yali atera obutatuula wansi kwogera nabo bokka. Kaakano, oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’emirimu mingi, abatwala mu bukiika kkono ewala ennyo ow’ensi, mu bitundu ebyetoolodde Kayisaliya ekya Firipo, ku njegoyego z’olusozi Herumooni. Bwe baali batambula, omusomesa n’akyukira abayigirizwa be n’ababuuza ebibuuzo bibiri. Ekibuuzo ekisooka kikwata ku ndowooza y’abantu ku Yesu, ate ekibuuzo ekiddako kikwata ku ndowooza y’abayigirizwa ku Yesu. Abayigirizwa bwe baamala okuddamu ekibuuzo ekisooka, n’addamu okubakyukira, n’ababuuza nti, “Mmwe mundowooza kuba ani?” (Matayo 16:15). Baali batuuse okutegeera nti Yesu yali asinga okuba omusajja omulungi oba omukozi w’ebyamagero? Simooni Peetero n’addamu nti, “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Yesu n’amugamba nti, “Olina omukisa Simooni, omwana wa Yona, kubanga ekyo Kitange ali mu ggulu y’akikubikkulidde, so tokiggye mu bantu. Era nkutegeeza nti, Ggwe Peetero, olwazi, era ku lwazi okwo kwe ndizimba Ekkanisa yange, n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula. Era ndikuwa ebisumuluzo by’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu; era kyonna ky’onoosibanga ku nsi, ne mu ggulu kinaasibwanga, na buli ky’onoosumululanga ku nsi, ne mu ggulu kinaasumululwanga” (Matayo 16:16-19). Okumala ebyasa bingi, Ekkanisa Enkatuliki ey’e Rooma yayigiriza nti kino kye kiragiro ekyaweebwa bapaapa bonna, nga basikira Peetero, omukulu w’ekkanisa, okugoba mu kkanisa bakabaka, amawanga, n’abantu abatawagira biragiro byabwe, oba okugaba obusonyiyo. Tekyandibadde kya kitalo singa wabeera n’ekisumuluzo eky’obwakabaka ku lw’abo b’oyagala? Ku lwa munno gw’ofumbiriganwa naye? Ku lw’omwana wo atalokoka? Ku lwa bazadde bo? Singa osobola okubaggulirawo ekkubo ery’obulamu obutaggwaawo! Kale, nzikiriza nti tulina obusobozi obwo! Kya mazima nti bangi bakuumibwa wala n’essanyu ery’okulaba n’okuyingira mu bwakabaka olw’okulemererwa kwaffe okuba abajulirwa be twandibadde. Ekitundu ekinene eky’okulemererwa okwo kiri mu mitima gyaffe egitasonyiwa. Waliwo bazadde bangi leero abasaba, nga bakaaba, ku lw’omwana waabwe eyawaba, nga tebategeera nti obutasonyiwa bwe balina ku mwana oyo bwe buziyiza okusinga byonna Katonda okuddamu essaala! Yesu yali ategeeza ki mu kitundu ekisembayo eky’olunyiriri lwaggulu? Mpeereddwa ennyinyonnyola nnyingi, okuva ku ‘buyinza’ bwa bapaapa, okutuuka ku ‘kununulibwa mu badayimooni,’ naye siraba na kimu ku ebyo wano. Kya nkola nnungi ey’okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa, bw’oba otunuulira olunyiriri olutategeerekeka bulungi, okunoonya ennyiriri ezifaanagana, naddala ezaava mu mwandiisi omu. Mu mbeera eno, tetulina kugenda wala nnyo, kubanga oluvannyuma lw’essuula bbiri zokka, Matayo addamu okukiwandiika. “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti byonna bye mulisiba ku nsi, ne mu ggulu birisibwa ne bye mulisumulula ku nsi, ne mu ggulu bigenda kusumululwa” (Matayo 18:18). Ku mulundi guno Mukama ayogera n’abayigirizwa bonna, si Peetero yekka. Obanga ebisumuluzo byaweebwa okusumulula n’okusiba (nga bwe bikozesebwa bulijjo ebisumuluzo!), kale byaweebwa abayigirizwa bonna — nga mw’otwalidde nange naawe! Omusingi ogwokubiri ogw’okunnyonnyola obulungi Ebyawandiikibwa kwe kwekenneenya ebigambo ebikwetoolodde; kale tujja kutunuulira Mukama kye yali ayigiriza mu kitundu ekisigadde ekya Matayo 18. Amangu ago tulaba nti essuula yonna ekwata ku kuzzibwa obuggya, okutabagana, n’okusonyiwa. Ebifaananyi ebitonotono byogera ku kuba ng’abaana, abatalina bukuusa era abatakwata bukyayi — abakkiriza ng’abo tebeesittaza balala wadde okubafumita; era naffe tusaana twegendereze obutabaleetera kwesittala oba biwundu. Ekyokubiri kye ndaba kiri nti omuntu bw’afumitibwa oba n’alumizibwa, n’olwekyo n’agenda, omusumba omulungi ajja kuleka abalala n’azza ‘endiga’ eyo mu kisibo. Weetegereze nate nti olugero lwogera ku ‘ndiga’ so si ku ‘mbuzi.’ Lwogera ku bakkiriza, so si ku ‘babuze.’ Emirundi mingi, ‘omuntu ow’ekizibu’ bw’ava mu kkanisa, tukuba mu ngalo nga tugamba nti, “Kirungi agenze!” Katonda ky’asaba abasumba abaweereza, n’endiga endala, kwe kunoonya okuzzibwa kwabwe obuggya, so si okubagoba mu kussakimu. “Muganda wo bw’akusobyanga ogendanga gy’ali,” nga musooka okubeera mwekka na ye, n’ekigendererwa kimu — okunoonya okutegeeragana n’okutabagana (Matayo 18:15). Weetegereze ekigambo “okusobya . ” Emirundi mingi ennyo tugenda nga twesittadde, ekiviirako okwesittala okusingako obunene. Tetuweereddwa kiragiro kya ngeri eyo kya kugenda gye bali nga twesittadde — wabula nga batusobezzaako. Ekyawukanako kyokka kyandibadde nga omusumba w’ekkanisa oba abakadde bwe bawulira nga kyetaagisa okusemberera omuntu gwe balowooza nti bulijjo y’aleeta okwesittala, oba asobezza ku balala. Mu mbeera eyo, ekigendererwa eky’okumusemberera bulijjo kiba kya kutabagana. Yesu bw’aba ng’awa okuyigiriza okwa Matayo 18:18-20, ekibuuzo kijja eri Peetero ng’abuuza Mukama emirundi emeka gy’asaanidde okusonyiwa. “Emirundi musanvu?” (Matayo 18:22). Peetero oboolyawo yalowooza nti ekibuuzo kye kyandibadde kirungi, naye Mukama n’akikozesa okussa essira nti okusonyiwa tekulina kkomo. Okwagala kutulagira okusonyiwanga bulijjo. Essuula 18 yonna ekwata ku kuzzibwa obuggya, okutabagana, n’okusonyiwa, byonna nga tolese kwesittala ku bubwo… kye kigambo ekikulu eky’ekitabo kino! Yokaana 20:23 Olunyiriri luno lwe lulala olufaanagana n’ennyiriri ebbiri ezaggulu, wadde nga lwawandiikibwa Yokaana mu Yokaana 20:23. Mu lunyiriri luno, abayigirizwa bonna bali mu kisenge ekisibiddwa kubanga batya nti abakulembeze b’Abayudaaya bajja kujja mangu okubatwala, nga bwe baatwala Mukama waabwe. Enneewulira zaabwe ziri waggulu nnyo, era abamu abaaliwo baagamba nti baali balabye Mukama, ng’azuukidde mu bafu! Olugero lwali lubuna nti Yesu yali alabikidde Peetero ne Maliyamu Magudaleene awamu n’abalala babiri ku kkubo ery’e Emawu. Abalala tebandikkirizza okuggyako nga nabo balabye Mukama azuukidde. Amangu ago, wadde ng’enzigi zaali nsibe, Yesu n’ayimirira wakati mu bo! N’agamba nti, “Emirembe gibe mu mmwe. Nga Kitange bwe yantuma, nange bwe mbatuma mmwe… Mufune Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Yokaana 20:21-22). Ekiseera ky’Oluyonaani eky’ekigambo “mufune,” kye kiragiro ekiyitibwa ‘aorist imperative’ ekyetaagisa bulijjo okwanukula amangu ago. Mu kaseera ako, abayigirizwa baafuna obulamu bwabwe obuggya mu Mwoyo. Oluvannyuma, ku lunaku lwa Pentekoote, bandifunye okujjula kwe okubawa amaanyi ag’okuweereza. Baali baweereddwa obuyinza obuggya! “Buli muntu gwe munaasonyiwanga ebibi bye anaabanga asonyiyiddwa. Abo be munaagaananga okusonyiwa, banaabanga tebasonyiyiddwa” (Yokaana 20:23). Kkirizaayo nkinnyonnyole mu bugazi, “Abo be musumulula (be muteera eddembe) basumululwa; abo be musiba, basibwa.” “Ani ayinza okusonyiwa ebibi okuggyako Katonda?” (Makko 2:7) Abafalisaayo bwe baabuuza. Mu ngeri emu, baali batuufu kubanga ekiragiro Mukama kye yatuwa ‘tekisonyiwa’ bibi mu kigero kye kimu ng’okusonyiwa kwe. Ye bw’asonyiwa, kiba nga “Ebibi byaffe abituggyako n’abitwala wala ng’ebuvanjuba bw’eri ewala okuva ebugwanjuba,” okutuuka mu buziba bw’ennyanja, nga tebiddayo kujjukirwa nate (Zabbuli 103:12) . Nze naawe tetusobola kukola ekyo — ku bibi byaffe ffe, so nga si ku by’omulala yenna. Ebibi byokka bye tusobola ‘okusonyiwa’ bye biri ebyakolebwa ku ffe — ebibi ebiyinza okuba nga bye byaleeta ebiwundu eby’emmeeme bye twetisse, Setaani mw’ayitidde okutuziyiza. Okuggyawo Ekiziyiza eky’Ekibi Bwe nkusobyako, mba nsobezza ne ku Katonda. Amangu ago, ekiziyiza kijja wakati wange ne Mukama wange. Nsanga nga kizibu okusaba, Ekigambo ne kifiirwa okunsikiriza, era n’okussakimu ne kutaba kuwoomerevu — ekibi kyange kifuuse ekire waggulu w’omutwe gwange! Waliwo engeri bbiri ‘ekire’ ekyo mwe kiyinza okuggyibwawo. Ey’olubereberye kwe “kwatula ekibi kyange, [kubanga] Ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okunsonyiwa ekibi kyange n’okunnaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna!” (1 Yokaana 1:9). Aleruya! Nkisanze nga ekisuubizo ekyo kya mazima. Naye era nkizudde nti Mukama alina ‘omuze’ guno omutono ogw’okwogera nange ku kibi ekyo. Ng’amaze okunsonyiwa, n’alyoka awuguuma mu mmeeme yange nti, “Kaakano, genda eri muganda wo alyoke akusonyiwe. Sireetedde kukunaazaako kibi kyokka, naye njagala okukulaba ng’otabagana.” Ekikulu eri Ye si kusonyiwa — kwe kutabagana! Okwatula tekutuukiridde okuggyako nga kuleese okutabagana. Ekyo si buvunaanyizibwa bwe — bwange, kubanga “Kristo yatukomyawo eri Katonda era ne tuweebwa obuweereza obw’okutabaganya” (2 Abakkolinso 5:18-19). Engeri ey’okubiri ‘ekire’ kyange mwe kiyinza okuggyibwawo, eggulu ne liddamu okunzigulirwa, kwe kuba nti ggwe okiggyawo ng’onsonyiye. Enkyusa ya Baibuli eya King James ekozesa ekigambo eky’enjawulo mu kuvvuunula Yokaana 20:23, awagamba nti, “Buli gw’oliggyako ebibi bye…” Ekigambo “okuggyako” kyogera ku ‘kuteeka ku bbali.’ Osobola okuggyawo ekibi kyange, ekyakolebwa ku ggwe, era mu kukola ekyo, n’onziguliriza eggulu. Bw’oteeka ekibi kyange ‘ku bbali,’ oggyawo ‘ekire,’ n’ekkubo ne liba ggule Kitaffe okwogera nange nga bwe kyali bwe nnasaba okusonyiyibwa kwe ku lwange. Ajja kuddamu okukwata ku mutima gwange, aleete okutabagana kwaffe! Oyinza okusalawo okunsonyiwa kubanga omanyi nti Ebyawandiikibwa bikilagira, naye kyetaagisa nnyo, bwe tuba tugenda okutabagana, nti era onsumulule okuva mu musango gwa Katonda ogunneetisse, ng’onoonya okuteeka ku bbali ‘ekire’ eky’ekibi ekiri waggulu wange. Bulijjo njogera ku “kusonyiwa n’okuteera eddembe” — biteekwa okubuulirwa awamu! Ekyokulabirako ekirungi kyandibadde Suteefano, omujulizi eyasooka okufa. Yali yaakalondebwa okuba omukulembeze mu kkanisa esooka, abakulembeze b’Abayudaaya bwe baamutwala ne bamukuba amayinja n’afa. Sawulo ow’e Taluso yali ayimiridde awo, ng’akkiriziganya nnyo n’ebikolwa byabwe, kubanga yali akyawa nnyo abagoberezi ba Yesu bano. Suteefano bwe yali afa, n’akaaba mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Mukama wange, tobavunaana olw’ekibi kino!” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:60). Teyasabira ku bubwe buvumu, maanyi, wadde n’okuteebwa eddembe, wabula yabateera eddembe okuva mu musango gwabwe. Neebuuza, Sawulo yandifuuse omutume omukulu Pawulo, singa Suteefano teyasaba ssaala eyo? Nzikiriza nti ye yaggulirawo Sawulo eggulu! Ne Yesu yasaba essaala efaanagana bwe yakaaba nti, “Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga kye bakola tebakimanyi” (Lukka 23:34), bwe yali afiirira nze naawe. Ekivaamu ekimu eky’ekitalo eky’okuteera abalala eddembe kiri nti naffe tuteebwa eddembe! Kiri ng’okuba n’embalaasi ku nkomerero y’omuguwa — twandigambye nti embalaasi esibiddwa ng’etwetooloola mu ddundiro; naye embalaasi bw’esalawo okudduka n’eyita ku ttale ery’ettosi, tugenda kuwalulwa mu ttosi okuggyako nga tuleka omuguwa! Ekifundikwa ky’owulira mu lubuto lwo ng’omuntu akusobezzaako, kiri ng’omuguwa ogwo. Osibiddwa mu nneewulira eri abo abakulumya . Obulumi obwo kitundu ku kiwundu kye baaleeta. Wadde ng’obasonyiye, ekifundikwa kiba wo buli lw’obasisinkana oba ng’owulira omuntu ng’ayogera ku bo. Ggwe, era nabo, mwetaaga okuteebwa eddembe! Yesu Wakati mu Bo Kya nnaku engeri Matayo 18:18-20 gy’ajulizibwamu emirundi mingi ng’aggyibbwa mu bigambo ebimwetoolodde! Ennyiriri zino zoogera ku kusonyiwa, okuteera eddembe, n’okutabagana; si ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda ng’abantu bangi bakuŋŋaanye! Ebisuubizo bya Yesu ebiweereddwa awo, bya abo abanoonya n’obunyiikivu okutabagana. “Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe” (Matayo 18:19-20). Essira erissibwa wano si ku kubeerawo kwe, kubanga bulijjo ali ne buli omu ku ffe abakkiriza, wabula ku mukisa gwe ogw’okutabagana — kye kintu ky’asinga okussa mu maaso! Tuweereddwa ekisumuluzo ekijja okuggulirawo abalala eggulu era ekijja okututeera eddembe okuva mu biwundu, n’obusibe bwe baaleeta mu mmeeme zaffe! Ka tuyige okukozesa ekisumuluzo ekyo!

fields.title: Eggulu Liggulwawo
fields.body_html:
Mu bulamu bwange ndabye eby'amagero bingi — nga mwe muli n'okuwonyezebwa okw'omubiri okuwerako. Nnaliwo omuwala ow'emyaka kkumi n'ebiri eyali kiggala nga era tayogera bwe yawulira n'asobola okwogera omulundi ogusooka. Nnalaba omukazi eyazaalibwa nga mulema ng'atambula oluvannyuma lw'okusabirwa. Nnalaba ekizimba ekinene nga kibulawo ku bulago bw'omukazi ng'akyasabirwa.

Naye newankubadde eby'amagero bino byansanyusa ne binzizaamu amaanyi, tebyali bya kitalo kusinga eby'amagero eby'okuwonyezebwa kw'emmeeme bye ndabye mu myaka egiyise, ng'abakkiriza abaliko ebiwundu bakozesa “ekisumuluzo ky'obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu” okusumulula abo abaabaleetera ebiwundu, era n'okwesumulula bo bennyini.

Ebyafaayo bino byesigamiziddwa ku bintu ebyabaawo ddala, okuggyako amannya n'ebifo bye nkyusizza okukuuma ekyama ky'abo be bikwatako; naye sifudde bivaamu mu ngeri yonna, era ngezezzaako okuba omwesigwa mu kunyumya omulimu gwa Mukama ogw'ekyamagero.

Marie

Nnasooka okusisinkana Marie ng'alina emyaka amakumi abiri mu munaana. Ababuulirizi be baali bagezaako okumuteeka mu bujjanjabi bw'endwadde z'omutwe, era yali anyolwa nnyo mu mutima nga yeeyawudde ku bantu. Yannyumiza ku buto bwe obw'ennaku; yakulira mu maka ag'Abajulizi ba Yakuwa amakakali mu Kanada, gye baali batakuza mazaalibwa wadde Ssekukkulu. Teyalina kujjukira kwonna kwa kwagala okuva eri omuzadde yenna; teyawulirangako kitaawe ng'amugamba nti amwagala, era teyamugwangamu kifuba wadde okumunywegera.

Ng'alina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, Marie yaddukira ewaabwe. Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mitono, yawulira amawulire amalungi ag'Enjiri, era amangu ago ne yeewaayo eri Kristo, ng'ayagala okumuweereza.

Ekkanisa entono ey'omu kitundu yamulabirira mu myaka egyo egyasooka ng'akyalwanagana n'okumanya ani gw'ali n'enneewulira ye. Ku mulundi ogumu waagezesebwa okutabagana n'ab'ewaabwe, naye ekyo kyaleeta obulumi bungi, kubanga waavaayo empaka ku ngeri ez'enjawulo gye baali bategeeramu Ebyawandiikibwa. Okwawukana kwabwe kwali kwa busungu, era Marie n'asalawo nti taddeyo kulaba bazadde be. “Mbakyawa,” bwe yaŋŋamba mu kusisinkana kwaffe okusooka.

Mu myezi egyaddirira, nnamala essaawa nnyingi ne Marie. Yantunuulira nga kitaawe, nange ne ndaba mu ye akaana akato akatakulanga. Ebikolwa bye bingi byali bya muvubuka atannakula, wadde nga yali asomye bulungi era ng'ayogera n'ennimi bbiri.

Yali mukozi wa maanyi era ng'amanyi bulungi omulimu gwe yaweebwa, naye enneewulira ye n'endowooza ye byali bya muvubuka atalina bukuumi mu mutima. Twayogera ku bintu bingi, naye buli lwe waayogerwako ku bazadde be, wakati waffe ne wabaawo ekisenge.

Oluvannyuma nnasobola okumunnyonnyola nti Katonda yali amutonze ng'ekibya ekifaanana ng'omutima, ekyategekebwa okufuna okwagala okuva eri maama we ne taata we. Okwagala okwo tekulagibwa nnyo mu kugaba by'okulya ebiwoomerera n'ebirabo, wabula mu kukuza obukuumi, omuwendo gw'omuntu, okumanya ani gw'oli, okubudaabudibwa, n'okukkirizibwa, nga bagumya ebiruubirirwa n'ebigendererwa, n'ebirala bingi — ebintu Marie bye yali atafunanga.

Marie yali mwetegefu okukkiriza nti bazadde be baamwonoona bwe baalemwa okumufukira okwagala kuno, naye kyali kizibu nnyo okumunnyonnyola nti bazadde be tebaali ba njawulo ku ffe abasinga obungi. Batambulira mu kizikiza, nga beetisse ebiwundu byabwe bo — obulemu bwabwe obw'omunda — ng'abaakosebwa ebirumbo bya Sitaani. Tebaalina kwagala kulumya Marie, era oboolyawo tebaamanya biwundu bye yali yeetisse.

“Njagala owandiikire bazadde bo ebbaluwa,” bwe nnamugamba. “Toweeraliikirira! Tojja kugiweereza, naye njagala olowooze ku ky'oyinza okwogera mu bbaluwa ng'eyo. Babuulire mu bujjuvu engeri gye baakulumya, ng'owa n'ebyokulabirako. Era babuulire engeri gy'oyaayaanira okwagala kwabwe.”

Guno mulimu gwe nkozesa emirundi mingi mu kubuulirira kwange, kubanga guyamba oyo gwe mbuulirira okuleeta ku lwatu ebyo ebyali bikwese mu birowoozo bye eby'omunda.

Ebbaluwa teweerezebwa, naye ewa oyo agiwandiise ekintu ekikwatibwako ky'asobola okussaako omwoyo. Kyatwala Marie wiiki ssatu ez'amaziga okumaliriza ebbaluwa ye. Bwe twasaba nga tusaba Mukama aluŋŋamye ebirowoozo bye, yeewuunya ebijjukizo bye yamuzzaayo.

Ebbaluwa bwe yaggwa, nnayitibwa okugisoma. Kino si kya nkizo eri oyo abuulirira, era mbuulira bulungi buli gwe mbuulirira nti tebeetaaga kundaga bye bawandiise. Mu bbaluwa eno mwalimu obulumi bungi nnyo, era omutima gwange ne gulumirirwa akaana kano akaabula, akaali keekwese mu mubiri gw'omukazi omukulu.

Nnafunya olupapula ne ndudda mu bbaasa yaalwo. “Marie, kaakano onoosalawo okusonyiwa bazadde bo n'okubasumulula?”

Bwe nnamubuuza. “Sisobola!” n'akaaba ng'amaziga gamukulukuta. Nnamugamba nti sikyalina kirala kya kukola; eddagala ery'ebiwundu bye kaakano lyali mu mikono gye, era “ekisumuluzo ky'obwakabaka” kyali kikye singa asalawo okukikozesa.

Waayitawo wiiki endala ssatu, Marie n'alyoka afukamira mu ofiisi yange, era ng'akaaba nnyo amaziga, n'agamba Mukama nti asonyiye bazadde be era ng'amwegayirira “obutababalira kibi kyabwe.” N'alyoka andagaanyisa nti anaasabiranga bazadde be omukisa buli lunaku.

Oluvannyuma lwa wiiki ntonotono, bwe nnalaba Marie ng'akula mu bwesige, nnamugamba nti njagala addeyo eka akyalire bazadde be ennaku ntonotono. Yaawakanya nnyo, naye ku nkomerero n'akkiriza okubawandiikira alabe oba banaamusembeza.

Oluvannyuma lwa wiiki bbiri, yayingira mu ofiisi yange ng'adduka, ng'ajjudde essanyu. Yali afunye bbaasa erimu ebbaluwa bbiri: emu ennyimpi nga eva eri maama we ng'agamba nti asembeddwa, n'endala empanvu nga eva eri taata we. Ey'oluvannyuma yali ya bukalu era nga nnyogovu, ng'amubuulira nti baali bakyuse amaka era nti bwe yandizze, olugendo lwandibadde luwanvu. Yandyetaaze okukwata eggaali y'omukka ey'enkya mu Toronto, n'akyusa e Montreal, n'alyoka atuuka ewaabwe ekiro nnyo. Yali tamanyi bulungi oba anaamulaba kubanga yalina emirimu mingi; naye ekyasinga okusanyusa Marie kwe kuba nti yamaliriza ebbaluwa ye n'ebigambo bino: “Nkugwa mu kifuba era nkunywegera, Taata!”

Bwe nnasibula Marie ku ggaali y'omukka mu Toronto, nnamugamba nti nnaamusabira, era ne mmukubiriza obutayingira mpaka zonna ez'eddiini. “Nga tonnava eyo,” bwe nnamugamba, “kakasa nti osaba taata wo okukugwa mu kifuba n'okukunywegera.” Yali abuusabuusa oba anaafuna obuvumu, naye nnamukakasa nti nnaamusabira olw'ekyo.

Ekiro ekyo bwe kyawungeera nnafuna essimu. “Gareth, ye nze, Marie.” Eddoboozi lye lyali lijjudde essanyu era nga tayinza na kwezibiira ng'annyumiza ebyaliwo. Bwe yali akyusa okuva ku ggaali emu okudda ku ndala mu Montreal, amangu ago n'alengera maama we ne taata we nga bayimiridde awo! Baali batambudde olugendo oluwanvu okumusisinkana. Marie yali atambula ng'agenda gye bali, amangu ago taata we n'asembera mu maaso, n'amugwa mu kifuba n'amunywegera! Nga bamalayika ab'omu ggulu bwe baasanyuka!

Naye kiki ekyali kibaddewo? Nzikiriza nti Marie yali aggulidde taata we eggulu olw'okusaba kwe okw'okusumulula. Ku makya ago, Kitaawe ow'omu ggulu yali ayogedde ng'ayita mu “luggi olwo olwaggulwa” eri taata we ow'oku nsi, n'amuleetera okuwummula ku mulimu olunaku olumu, n'atwala mukyala we mu lugendo okusisinkana muwala waabwe. Awo n'akwata omutima gwe, n'amuleetera okugolola emikono mu kwagala n'anywegera Marie omulundi ogusooka ddala. Mazima ddala, taata teyali amanyi nti enteekateeka ze n'ebikolwa bye byali biluŋŋamizibwa Katonda.

Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka ebiri, Marie yali akuze n'afuuka omuwala omulamu bulungi era omulungi. Yatabagana ddala n'ab'ewaabwe, era n'asenguka n'agenda mu kibuga kyabwe. Yafuuka omunyiikivu mu kkanisa ye ey'Enjiri, era n'alondebwa okuba omudiikoni omukazi. Tekyatwala bbanga ddene Marie n'afuna omwami mu kkanisa, nga balina enteekateeka ey'okuweereza Mukama nga ababaka b'Enjiri. Katonda mulungi nnyo!

Angela

“Kiki ekindiko, Gareth?” Angela bwe yakaaba, ng'amaze okutuula ku ntebe ey'omu ofiisi yange. “Buli nkya nzuukuka nga nzijjudde okutya nti nnaaba nkoze ensobi bwe nnaafumbirwa John.”

N'ayongera okunnyonnyola nti buli nkya yabanga amaliridde okumaliriza olukwano lwabwe, naye olunaku bwe lwagendanga mu maaso, yakimanyanga nti tasobola, kubanga John yali mulenzi mulungi omuwala yenna gwe yandyenyumiririzzaamu okufumbirwa. Yali Mukristaayo omumalirivu era yamuyisanga mu kitiibwa n'okwagala. Bye baayagala byali bifaanagana, era bombi baali baagala okuweereza Mukama mu mulimu gw'obubaka bw'Enjiri.

Angela yamanya nti ekizibu kyali kikye, kubanga luno lwali si lukwano lwe olusooka mwe yawulira okutya okufaanana ng'okwo. Emirundi ebiri yali amazeeko enkwano ennungi, n'alyoka akaaba amaziga wiiki nnyingi ng'yeebuuza lwaki yali akoze “eby'obusirusiru bwe bityo.”

Mu kubuulirira kwaffe, yannyumiza ku taata we eyali omukadde mu kkanisa ey'Enjiri ennywevu. Yamussangamu ekitiibwa kinene, naye yawulira nti taasobolanga kumumatiza. Yali akimanyisizza nti ku mwana we omubereberye yali ayagadde omulenzi mu kifo ky'omuwala. Bwe yali akula, Angela yazannyanga kirikiti ne taata we ne baganda be abato. Yali mulungi mu mizannyo, naye teyatuukanga ku baganda be, bw'atyo n'atafunanga bitendo bye baafunanga. Bwe yafuna ekibiina A ku ssomero, yabuuzibwa lwaki tekyali A+. Bwe yafuna omulimu gwe ogusooka mu bbanka, yagambibwa nti yandisabye mu bbanka endala esinga obulungi. Teyawuliranga kitaawe ng'amutendereza oba ng'amunyweza, wadde nga yagezaako nnyo okumusanyusa.

Nnamulaga nti taata we yali alemereddwa okumuwa okumanya ani gw'ali n'omuwendo gwe, era nti obwesige bwe bwali bwa wansi kubanga bulijjo yeerabanga ng'atasobola kumatiza basajja abaali mu bulamu bwe.

Sitaani yali akozesa ebiwundu ebyava mu taata we obutamukkiriza, okumulemesa okukulaakulanya olukwano olw'okutya Katonda ne John. Angela yalaba engeri ebintu gye byali bigenda, n'ategeera engeri gy'ayinza okumenya obuddu ng'awonya ebiwundu bye ng'ayita mu kusumulula taata we. Twasaba ffenna ng'asaba Mukama “obutabalira kitange kibi kino.”

Oluvannyuma lwa wiiki ntonotono, Angela n'afuna amayinja mu nsigo.

N'ava mu kitundu mwe twali tukolera awamu n'addayo mu ssaza ly'ewaabwe, gye yali ateekwa okuyingira eddwaliro alongoosebwe.

Oluvannyuma lw'emyezi ebiri, bwe nnamusisinkana omulundi ogusooka kasookedde alongoosebwa, yanjiira ng'adduka, n'angwa mu kifuba, era n'essanyu lingi, n'annyumiza olugero olw'ekitalo.

Bwe yatuuka eka, taata we n'alangirira nti agenda kuwummula ku mulimu wiiki ttaano asobole okuzimala ne muwala we! Yamutwalanga okulya emmere mu bifo eby'enjawulo n'okukyala mu bifo eby'ettutumu eby'omu kitundu. Baayogeranga bombi, ne bazuula ebintu bingi ku muntu ne munne bye baali batamanyi. Waaliwo n'okukyala kungi mu bifo taata we mwe yakolera, era mu buli kifo Angela yakwatibwanga ensonyi kubanga taata we yeenyumirizanga muwala we n'ebintu eby'ekitalo bye yali akola. Yali amwenyumiririzaamu nnyo!

“Gareth,” bwe yaŋŋamba, “ntuuse okwagala taata wange!” N'ayongerako nti, “era nnali sisobola na kugumiikiriza kudda kulaba John.”

John ne Angela baafumbiriganwa nga basanyufu, era awamu ne baweereza Mukama n'essanyu.

Kiki ekyaleetera taata we okuwummula ku mulimu wiiki ttaano azimale ne muwala we? Kiyinzika okuba nga yali Mukama ng'ayogera naye ng'ayita mu luggi olwaggulwa okusaba kwa Angela okw'okusumulula? Mazima nzikiriza bwe kityo.

Tony

Kyatwala Tony okufuba nnyo okufuna obuvumu okujja gye ndi. Teyategeeragananga bulungi na musajja yenna, kubanga yakulira ku maama we oluvannyuma lw'okugattululwa okw'obusungu.

Kasookedde ava mu ssomero, yali akoze emirimu mingi egy'enjawulo, naye n'alemwa okunywerera ku gumu ku gyo. Nnawuliriza ng'ampa ebyokwewolereza bye, era amangu ne ndaba nti bulijjo ekyaddiŋŋananga kwe kugamba nti kyali “kya musobyo gwa mukulu wange ku mulimu.”

Twayogera ku buto bwe, ku bwerere bwe, ne ku ngeri gye yali atayagalamu ssomero. Amangu ne kirabika nti yali atya nnyo omu ku basomesa be. Yali si muyizi mugezi nnyo, era omusomesa ono yali mukambwe nnyo mu bimu ku bye yakola n'ebye yayogera. Omusomesa we yalabikanga ng'asanyukira okuleetera abayizi be obutabeera bulungi mu kibiina, era ng'akwasa ensonyi abo abalina emmeeme ennafu ng'abasekerera mu maaso g'ekibiina kyonna. Tony ye yalumbibwanga emirundi mingi ebigambo bye ebifumita.

Ate era waaliwo n'okutiisibwatiisibwa. Tewaayitanga wiiki nga Tony tatiisiddwatiisiddwa nti anaatwalibwa eri omukulu w'essomero kubanga omulimu gwe gwali “tegutuuka ku mutindo.” Newankubadde nga yeeyongera okufuba, teyasobolanga kumatiza musomesa ono, era yaweebwanga emirimu emirala egy'okwongerezaako. Yasanyuka nnyo bwe yatuuka emyaka egy'okuva mu ssomero n'atandika okufuna ssente; naye amangu ne kirabika nti ebiwundu byali bikyaliwo, kubanga Tony teyasobolanga kutegeeragana na musajja yenna ow'obuyinza era ow'amaanyi. Buli lwe yaweebwanga omulimu ogutali gwa kusanyusa, yagutwalanga ng'ekibonerezo ekimuweereddwa omukulu w'emirimu eyali amukyawa. Teyasobolanga kulaba nti gwali mulimu ogwali gusuubirwa buli mukozi omuto mu kkampuni eyo.

Nnamunnyonnyola engeri emirundi mingi gye tufunamu ebiwundu olw'ebikolwa oba ebigambo by'abalala, n'engeri ebiwundu ebyo gye bitulemesaamu okutambulira mu bulamu obw'eddembe Yesu lye yatugulira ku musaalaba.

Tony yategeera engeri omusomesa we gye yakozesebwa Sitaani okufumita emmeeme ye. Twasaba ffenna ng'asalawo okusonyiwa n'okusaba Mukama asonyiwe omusomesa oyo. Yeewaayo okusabira ab'omu maka ge, na ddala batabani be abaali bajeemu nnyo, ekyali kireetedde bazadde baabwe obulumi bungi mu mutima.

Amangu ago omukisa gw'omulimu omulala ne guggulwawo, era Tony n'agusaba. Yaweebwa omulimu era n'atandika mu nnaku ntonotono.

Oluvannyuma lw'omwaka gumu, n'akuzibwa n'afuuka omukulu w'abakozi kubanga yali akoze enkolagana ennungi nnyo ne banne be yakolanga nabo. Era, nga nnannyini kkampuni bwe yalangirira, “Osobola okumuwa omulimu gwonna era n'omanya nti gujja kukolebwa bulungi. Ye musajja gwe nsobola okwesiga!” Katonda yali akoze omulimu omulungi.

Marie yali atambula ng'agenda gye bali, amangu ago taata we n'asembera mu maaso, n'amugwa mu kifuba n'amunywegera! Nga bamalayika ab'omu ggulu bwe baasanyuka! Naye kiki ekyali kibaddewo? Nzikiriza nti Marie yali aggulidde taata we eggulu olw'okusaba kwe okw'okusumulula. Ku makya ago, Kitaawe ow'omu ggulu yali ayogedde ng'ayita mu “luggi olwo olwaggulwa” eri taata we ow'oku nsi, n'amuleetera okuwummula ku mulimu olunaku olumu, n'atwala mukyala we mu lugendo okusisinkana muwala waabwe. Awo n'akwata omutima gwe, n'amuleetera okugolola emikono mu kwagala n'anywegera Marie omulundi ogusooka ddala. Mazima ddala, taata teyali amanyi nti enteekateeka ze n'ebikolwa bye byali biluŋŋamizibwa Katonda. Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka ebiri, Marie yali akuze n'afuuka omuwala omulamu bulungi era omulungi. Yatabagana ddala n'ab'ewaabwe, era n'asenguka n'agenda mu kibuga kyabwe. Yafuuka omunyiikivu mu kkanisa ye ey'Enjiri, era n'alondebwa okuba omudiikoni omukazi. Tekyatwala bbanga ddene Marie n'afuna omwami mu kkanisa, nga balina enteekateeka ey'okuweereza Mukama nga ababaka b'Enjiri. Katonda mulungi nnyo! Angela “Kiki ekindiko, Gareth?” Angela bwe yakaaba, ng'amaze okutuula ku ntebe ey'omu ofiisi yange. “Buli nkya nzuukuka nga nzijjudde okutya nti nnaaba nkoze ensobi bwe nnaafumbirwa John.” N'ayongera okunnyonnyola nti buli nkya yabanga amaliridde okumaliriza olukwano lwabwe, naye olunaku bwe lwagendanga mu maaso, yakimanyanga nti tasobola, kubanga John yali mulenzi mulungi omuwala yenna gwe yandyenyumiririzzaamu okufumbirwa. Yali Mukristaayo omumalirivu era yamuyisanga mu kitiibwa n'okwagala. Bye baayagala byali bifaanagana, era bombi baali baagala okuweereza Mukama mu mulimu gw'obubaka bw'Enjiri. Angela yamanya nti ekizibu kyali kikye, kubanga luno lwali si lukwano lwe olusooka mwe yawulira okutya okufaanana ng'okwo. Emirundi ebiri yali amazeeko enkwano ennungi, n'alyoka akaaba amaziga wiiki nnyingi ng'yeebuuza lwaki yali akoze “eby'obusirusiru bwe bityo.” Mu kubuulirira kwaffe, yannyumiza ku taata we eyali omukadde mu kkanisa ey'Enjiri ennywevu. Yamussangamu ekitiibwa kinene, naye yawulira nti taasobolanga kumumatiza. Yali akimanyisizza nti ku mwana we omubereberye yali ayagadde omulenzi mu kifo ky'omuwala. Bwe yali akula, Angela yazannyanga kirikiti ne taata we ne baganda be abato. Yali mulungi mu mizannyo, naye teyatuukanga ku baganda be, bw'atyo n'atafunanga bitendo bye baafunanga. Bwe yafuna ekibiina A ku ssomero, yabuuzibwa lwaki tekyali A+. Bwe yafuna omulimu gwe ogusooka mu bbanka, yagambibwa nti yandisabye mu bbanka endala esinga obulungi. Teyawuliranga kitaawe ng'amutendereza oba ng'amunyweza, wadde nga yagezaako nnyo okumusanyusa. Nnamulaga nti taata we yali alemereddwa okumuwa okumanya ani gw'ali n'omuwendo gwe, era nti obwesige bwe bwali bwa wansi kubanga bulijjo yeerabanga ng'atasobola kumatiza basajja abaali mu bulamu bwe. Sitaani yali akozesa ebiwundu ebyava mu taata we obutamukkiriza, okumulemesa okukulaakulanya olukwano olw'okutya Katonda ne John. Angela yalaba engeri ebintu gye byali bigenda, n'ategeera engeri gy'ayinza okumenya obuddu ng'awonya ebiwundu bye ng'ayita mu kusumulula taata we. Twasaba ffenna ng'asaba Mukama “obutabalira kitange kibi kino.” Oluvannyuma lwa wiiki ntonotono, Angela n'afuna amayinja mu nsigo. N'ava mu kitundu mwe twali tukolera awamu n'addayo mu ssaza ly'ewaabwe, gye yali ateekwa okuyingira eddwaliro alongoosebwe. Oluvannyuma lw'emyezi ebiri, bwe nnamusisinkana omulundi ogusooka kasookedde alongoosebwa, yanjiira ng'adduka, n'angwa mu kifuba, era n'essanyu lingi, n'annyumiza olugero olw'ekitalo. Bwe yatuuka eka, taata we n'alangirira nti agenda kuwummula ku mulimu wiiki ttaano asobole okuzimala ne muwala we! Yamutwalanga okulya emmere mu bifo eby'enjawulo n'okukyala mu bifo eby'ettutumu eby'omu kitundu. Baayogeranga bombi, ne bazuula ebintu bingi ku muntu ne munne bye baali batamanyi. Waaliwo n'okukyala kungi mu bifo taata we mwe yakolera, era mu buli kifo Angela yakwatibwanga ensonyi kubanga taata we yeenyumirizanga muwala we n'ebintu eby'ekitalo bye yali akola. Yali amwenyumiririzaamu nnyo! “Gareth,” bwe yaŋŋamba, “ntuuse okwagala taata wange!” N'ayongerako nti, “era nnali sisobola na kugumiikiriza kudda kulaba John.” John ne Angela baafumbiriganwa nga basanyufu, era awamu ne baweereza Mukama n'essanyu. Kiki ekyaleetera taata we okuwummula ku mulimu wiiki ttaano azimale ne muwala we? Kiyinzika okuba nga yali Mukama ng'ayogera naye ng'ayita mu luggi olwaggulwa okusaba kwa Angela okw'okusumulula? Mazima nzikiriza bwe kityo. Tony Kyatwala Tony okufuba nnyo okufuna obuvumu okujja gye ndi. Teyategeeragananga bulungi na musajja yenna, kubanga yakulira ku maama we oluvannyuma lw'okugattululwa okw'obusungu. Kasookedde ava mu ssomero, yali akoze emirimu mingi egy'enjawulo, naye n'alemwa okunywerera ku gumu ku gyo. Nnawuliriza ng'ampa ebyokwewolereza bye, era amangu ne ndaba nti bulijjo ekyaddiŋŋananga kwe kugamba nti kyali “kya musobyo gwa mukulu wange ku mulimu.” Twayogera ku buto bwe, ku bwerere bwe, ne ku ngeri gye yali atayagalamu ssomero. Amangu ne kirabika nti yali atya nnyo omu ku basomesa be. Yali si muyizi mugezi nnyo, era omusomesa ono yali mukambwe nnyo mu bimu ku bye yakola n'ebye yayogera. Omusomesa we yalabikanga ng'asanyukira okuleetera abayizi be obutabeera bulungi mu kibiina, era ng'akwasa ensonyi abo abalina emmeeme ennafu ng'abasekerera mu maaso g'ekibiina kyonna. Tony ye yalumbibwanga emirundi mingi ebigambo bye ebifumita. Ate era waaliwo n'okutiisibwatiisibwa. Tewaayitanga wiiki nga Tony tatiisiddwatiisiddwa nti anaatwalibwa eri omukulu w'essomero kubanga omulimu gwe gwali “tegutuuka ku mutindo.” Newankubadde nga yeeyongera okufuba, teyasobolanga kumatiza musomesa ono, era yaweebwanga emirimu emirala egy'okwongerezaako. Yasanyuka nnyo bwe yatuuka emyaka egy'okuva mu ssomero n'atandika okufuna ssente; naye amangu ne kirabika nti ebiwundu byali bikyaliwo, kubanga Tony teyasobolanga kutegeeragana na musajja yenna ow'obuyinza era ow'amaanyi. Buli lwe yaweebwanga omulimu ogutali gwa kusanyusa, yagutwalanga ng'ekibonerezo ekimuweereddwa omukulu w'emirimu eyali amukyawa. Teyasobolanga kulaba nti gwali mulimu ogwali gusuubirwa buli mukozi omuto mu kkampuni eyo. Nnamunnyonnyola engeri emirundi mingi gye tufunamu ebiwundu olw'ebikolwa oba ebigambo by'abalala, n'engeri ebiwundu ebyo gye bitulemesaamu okutambulira mu bulamu obw'eddembe Yesu lye yatugulira ku musaalaba. Tony yategeera engeri omusomesa we gye yakozesebwa Sitaani okufumita emmeeme ye. Twasaba ffenna ng'asalawo okusonyiwa n'okusaba Mukama asonyiwe omusomesa oyo. Yeewaayo okusabira ab'omu maka ge, na ddala batabani be abaali bajeemu nnyo, ekyali kireetedde bazadde baabwe obulumi bungi mu mutima. Amangu ago omukisa gw'omulimu omulala ne guggulwawo, era Tony n'agusaba. Yaweebwa omulimu era n'atandika mu nnaku ntonotono. Oluvannyuma lw'omwaka gumu, n'akuzibwa n'afuuka omukulu w'abakozi kubanga yali akoze enkolagana ennungi nnyo ne banne be yakolanga nabo. Era, nga nnannyini kkampuni bwe yalangirira, “Osobola okumuwa omulimu gwonna era n'omanya nti gujja kukolebwa bulungi. Ye musajja gwe nsobola okwesiga!” Katonda yali akoze omulimu omulungi.

fields.title: Yesu — Omuwonya
fields.body_html:
Ebibi Eby'emirembe

Mu myaka gyange egy'okubudaabuda abantu, nnayiga nti ebiwundu ebiziyiza abo be mbudaabuda mu kutambula kwabwe ne Mukama, emirundi mingi bisibuka mu bintu ebyabaawo emyaka mingi emabega. Oluusi waliwo obukakafu obulaga olunyiriri lw'ebiwundu ebifaanagana nga luyita mu mirembe egiwerako egyayita. Kya mazima mu Byawandiikibwa nti, “ebibi bya bakitaabwe bisobola okutuuka ku baana okutuusa ku mulembe ogwokusatu n'ogwokuna” (Okuva 20:5).

Ate era waaliwo ekiziyiza abaana abaazaalibwa mu bufumbo obutali butukuvu obutayingira mu kuŋŋaaniro lya Mukama mu bujjuvu “okutuusa ku mulembe ogw'ekkumi” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 23:2)! Bino bye bisala eby'Endagaano Enkadde ebiraga engeri ekibi gye kiyinza okukwatamu, si mwonoonyi yekka, wabula ne bazzukulu be bangi. Naye eky'essanyu, Yesu yajja okuggyawo ekikolimo ky'ekibi n'okututa mu ddembe okuva mu bikolwa byakyo; noolwekyo, tetuteekwa kusigala nga tuli busibe bw'ebiwundu eby'ebibi bya bazadde baffe.

Mukama ayagala tutambule nga tuli ba ddembe, naye tuyinza tutya okusumulula abo abaatuleetera ebiwundu nga bo baamala dda okufa? Bwe tuba nga tetusobola kubasumulula, ffe tuyinza okusumululwa? Bino bye bibuuzo bye ntera okubuuzibwa ng'abo be mbudaabuda bategedde ebiwundu eby'emabega n'engeri gye bikwatamu obulamu bwabwe obwa kaakano. Tetukkiriza nti okusabira abafu kuyinza okukyusa mu ngeri yonna embeera yaabwe mu maaso ga Katonda, Omulamuzi Omukulu; noolwekyo, eky'ennaku, tetusobola kubaggulirawo bwakabaka bwa ggulu.

Newankubadde nga tetusobola kukozesa kisumuluzo ky'obwakabaka kye twaweebwa, Mukama akyagenda kututa mu ddembe ng'ayita mu kuwona kwe yatugulira ku Kalvari, kubanga “Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya” (Isaaya 53:5).

Ebijjukizo Ebikwese

Buli lwe mbudaabuda omuntu, tutandika bulijjo nga tusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuluŋŋamya ebirowoozo byaffe. Twagala atubikkulire ebitundu by'emmeeme ebiyinza okubaamu ebiwundu.

Kinneewuunyisa bulijjo (wadde nga tekyandinneewuunyisizza) engeri ebijjukizo eby'ebintu ebyali byerabiddwa edda gye bikomawo nga bikulukuta! Ku lulala, nnali mbudaabuda omukyala ow'ekigero eyalina obuzibu mu nkolagana ye n'abantu. N'atandika okukaaba mpolampola nga tewali nsonga yeeyoleka.

Omuyambi wange, Debbie, n'asembera n'amwesiba mu mikono, era omukyala oyo n'atandika okukaaba nnyo nga tasobola kwerinda.

Debbie n'amutuuza ku maviivi ge n'amuwambaatira nga maama bw'awambaatira omwana omuto. Oluvannyuma lw'akaseera k'amaziga ag'obulumi obungi, omukyala n'atandika okukuba Debbie n'enkonde ng'akaaba nti, “Lwaki wakikola? Lwaki wakikola?”

Bwe yakkakkana, n'atubuulira nti yali alowooza nti akuba maama we olw'okusuula omudooli gwe ogw'engoye gwe yali ayagala ennyo, ng'akyalina emyaka ena gyokka! Omuwala omuto oyo yali yeetisse ekiwundu ekyo okumala emyaka egisukka mu 40 wadde nga teyali akijjukira! Kyali kiziikiddwa mu buziba bw'obwongo bwe.

Emirundi mingi abo be mbudaabuda bakomyewo okumbuulira nga bajjukidde amangu ekintu eky'obulumi ekyabaawo emabega. Sitera kutwala bujjukizo buno bwonna nga butuufu. Waliwo akabi kanene mu biseera bino kubanga abantu bangi baagala okuvunaana abalala olw'ebibi bye beeteesaako mu birowoozo byabwe, era nga baagala okwewala okuvunaanibwa olw'obunafu n'endowooza zaabwe ez'omu kiseera kino.

Ekyo si kye kigendererwa kyange mu kuwandiika ekitabo kino. Njagala okulaba abantu nga beevunaanira ebikolwa byabwe, nga bakozesa ekisumuluzo ky'obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu, nga beeta mu ddembe, era nga basumulula abo abayinza okuba nga baabaleetera ebiwundu. Bombi baabonyaabonyezebwa Setaani — bombi beetaaga okuteebwa mu ddembe. Okuvunaanagana tekuleeta ddembe n'akatono; okusonyiwa kwokka kwe kukuleeta!

Nga Bwe Yali Jjo, Ne Leero, Era Emirembe n'Emirembe

Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'abikkula ebiwundu, tuteekwa okuwaayo ekiseera okuleeta ekiwundu ekyo mu maaso ga Mukama, akikwateko akiwonye.

Ye “Alufa ne Omega, entandikwa n'enkomerero” (Okubikkulirwa 1:8). Ye “nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw'ali era bw'aliba emirembe n'emirembe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:8). Amanyi ekiwundu kyo — yaliwo bwe kyabaawo — era yakukaabira. Bwe tumuleetera ekiwundu, nga tusonyiye oyo eyakireeta, atandika okuwonya n'okuzza obuggya emmeeme. Newankubadde nga tetusobola kusumulula oyo eyatuleetera ekiwundu, Mukama mwesigwa okutuwonya n'okututa mu ddembe.

Ebbaluwa

Nze n'oyo gwe mbudaabuda bwe tumala okwogera, era ng'ategedde obulumi, ebiwundu, n'engeri gye bikwatamu obulamu bwe, mmusaba awandiikire ebbaluwa oyo eyamuleetera ekiwundu ng'annyonnyolamu ekiwundu ky'awulira n'obulumi bwe kyaleeta. Mmukubiriza ayoleke enneewulira ye n'ebyo bye yali ayaayaanira.

“Singa wategedde nga bwe wandumya bwe wakola… Nnayaayaanira nnyo okukuwulira ng'oŋŋamba nti wanjagala!”

Ebbaluwa eyinza okuba n'ebikwata ku buli kimu kubanga tegenda kusindikibwa. Ekigendererwa kyayo kwe kuleeta waggulu enneewulira n'obulumi byonna ebyali bikwese mu buziba bw'omutima. Ekiseera eky'okusonyiwa n'okusumulula (bwe kiba kisoboka) bwe kituuka, ebbaluwa eno efuuka ‘endagaano’ ey'okusonyiwa. “Weetegefu okusonyiwa buli kintu kye wawandiise wano?” bwe mbabuuza. Awo bwe mba nkakasizza nti bategedde bulungi bye mbayigirizza, era nti basonyiye ddala (era ne basumulula) oyo eyabasobya, mbasaba bazikirize ebbaluwa nga bajjukira ekifo n'olunaku lwe baakikolerako. Awo bakubirizibwa okusabira omukisa ku oyo eyabasobya, bw'aba nga akyali mulamu.

Okumaliriza okusumulula kwabwe, mmanyi abantu abaatwala ebbaluwa mu malaalo, ne bamansa evvu lyayo ne batereka n'ebimuli ku ntaana y'omugenzi. Eri abamu, luno lwe lwali olulundi olusooka okukungubagira ddala okufa kw'ow'omu maka gaabwe, ne ku muzadde, era ne bamanya okukwatibwako okuwonya okuddirira okukungubaga okwa nnamaddala.

Ekikolwa kyaffe eky'okusonyiwa nga tukimanyi kimenya amaanyi ga Setaani.

Mukama bw'akola omulimu gwe ogw'okuwonya mu bulamu bwaffe, tuyiga okutambulira mu maanyi g'Omwoyo we.

Bwe twambala ebyokulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda, omulabe asanga nga mu bulamu bwaffe tewali kifo kya bunafu ky'ayinza okuyitiramu okutuziyiza mu lutalo.

Mazima ddala, okusonyiwa si kikolwa kya mulundi gumu, wadde okwewaayo okw'emirundi musanvu. Nga Yesu bwe yayigiriza Peetero, kwetaagisa “emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu” (Matayo 18:22). Mu ngeri endala, tuteekwa okubeera n'omutima ogusonyiwa bulijjo.

Bulijjo tuteekwa okwanguwa okutabagana n'abo ebikolwa byabwe oba ebigambo byabwe ebiyinza okuleeta enjawukana wakati waffe. Kitugwanidde okutegeera nti oluusi kiyinza okwetaagisa okuwummuza omutima, naye tewali nsonga yonna ey'okusigaza obukyayi.

Ka twemalirire okukozesa ekisumuluzo ekiri mu ngalo zaffe, tulyoke tumanyibwe ng'“abatabaganya,” abo “abayitibwa baana ba Katonda” (Matayo 5:9).

Ye “Alufa ne Omega, entandikwa n'enkomerero” (Okubikkulirwa 1:8). Ye “nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw'ali era bw'aliba emirembe n'emirembe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:8). Amanyi ekiwundu kyo — yaliwo bwe kyabaawo — era yakukaabira. Bwe tumuleetera ekiwundu, nga tusonyiye oyo eyakireeta, atandika okuwonya n'okuzza obuggya emmeeme. Newankubadde nga tetusobola kusumulula oyo eyatuleetera ekiwundu, Mukama mwesigwa okutuwonya n'okututa mu ddembe. Ebbaluwa Nze n'oyo gwe mbudaabuda bwe tumala okwogera, era ng'ategedde obulumi, ebiwundu, n'engeri gye bikwatamu obulamu bwe, mmusaba awandiikire ebbaluwa oyo eyamuleetera ekiwundu ng'annyonnyolamu ekiwundu ky'awulira n'obulumi bwe kyaleeta. Mmukubiriza ayoleke enneewulira ye n'ebyo bye yali ayaayaanira. “Singa wategedde nga bwe wandumya bwe wakola… Nnayaayaanira nnyo okukuwulira ng'oŋŋamba nti wanjagala!” Ebbaluwa eyinza okuba n'ebikwata ku buli kimu kubanga tegenda kusindikibwa. Ekigendererwa kyayo kwe kuleeta waggulu enneewulira n'obulumi byonna ebyali bikwese mu buziba bw'omutima. Ekiseera eky'okusonyiwa n'okusumulula (bwe kiba kisoboka) bwe kituuka, ebbaluwa eno efuuka ‘endagaano’ ey'okusonyiwa. “Weetegefu okusonyiwa buli kintu kye wawandiise wano?” bwe mbabuuza. Awo bwe mba nkakasizza nti bategedde bulungi bye mbayigirizza, era nti basonyiye ddala (era ne basumulula) oyo eyabasobya, mbasaba bazikirize ebbaluwa nga bajjukira ekifo n'olunaku lwe baakikolerako. Awo bakubirizibwa okusabira omukisa ku oyo eyabasobya, bw'aba nga akyali mulamu. Okumaliriza okusumulula kwabwe, mmanyi abantu abaatwala ebbaluwa mu malaalo, ne bamansa evvu lyayo ne batereka n'ebimuli ku ntaana y'omugenzi. Eri abamu, luno lwe lwali olulundi olusooka okukungubagira ddala okufa kw'ow'omu maka gaabwe, ne ku muzadde, era ne bamanya okukwatibwako okuwonya okuddirira okukungubaga okwa nnamaddala. Ekikolwa kyaffe eky'okusonyiwa nga tukimanyi kimenya amaanyi ga Setaani. Mukama bw'akola omulimu gwe ogw'okuwonya mu bulamu bwaffe, tuyiga okutambulira mu maanyi g'Omwoyo we. Bwe twambala ebyokulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda, omulabe asanga nga mu bulamu bwaffe tewali kifo kya bunafu ky'ayinza okuyitiramu okutuziyiza mu lutalo. Mazima ddala, okusonyiwa si kikolwa kya mulundi gumu, wadde okwewaayo okw'emirundi musanvu. Nga Yesu bwe yayigiriza Peetero, kwetaagisa “emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu” (Matayo 18:22). Mu ngeri endala, tuteekwa okubeera n'omutima ogusonyiwa bulijjo. Bulijjo tuteekwa okwanguwa okutabagana n'abo ebikolwa byabwe oba ebigambo byabwe ebiyinza okuleeta enjawukana wakati waffe. Kitugwanidde okutegeera nti oluusi kiyinza okwetaagisa okuwummuza omutima, naye tewali nsonga yonna ey'okusigaza obukyayi. Ka twemalirire okukozesa ekisumuluzo ekiri mu ngalo zaffe, tulyoke tumanyibwe ng'“abatabaganya,” abo “abayitibwa baana ba Katonda” (Matayo 5:9).

fields.title: Okutambula mu Kkubo ery'Okuwona Kwo
fields.body_html:
Mu ngeri nnyingi, essuula eno ye esinga obuzibu okuwandiika. Emisingi egyayogeddwako mu ssuula ezaakulembera ngiyigirizza ebibiina by'abantu ab'engeri nnyingi ez'enjawulo. Waliwo ebibiina by'abavubuka n'abakadde, ekkanisa ez'enkola ez'edda n'ezo ezitagoberera nkola za dda, amasomero g'Ebyawandiikibwa n'ebibiina eby'omu maka. Kumpi mu byonna, waabaddewo okuddamu okuva ku mutima, ng'abantu bangi abakaaba bajja gye ndi okunoonya okubudaabudibwa.

Kimmwa ennaku okuba nti ntera kuba mpitawo buyisi, era nga sisobola kwewaayo mu lugendo oluwanvu olw'okutambula mu kkubo ery'okuwona bangi ku bo kwe beetaaga. Nkimanyi nti emirundi mingi mba ‘nzigudde ekiwundu’ — ekijjukizo ekyali kizikiddwa edda — ekyetaaga kaakano okuwonyezebwa.

Oluusi engeri gye baddamu tesuubirwa. Nzijukira ekkanisa emu ey'Abaepisikopo eyalimu abantu abakulu, abaakuba mu ngalo nga nze n'omusumba tuwambaatagana nga twoleka okutabagana okuddirira okusumulula. Baali bakimanyi bulungi nti baali beetaaga okusonyiwa n'okusumulula omusumba eyali akulembedde ekkanisa eyo; era essanyu ery'okutegeera okuggya engeri gye bandiggyibwako obulumi bwe baali beetisse, ne libaleetera okukuba mu ngalo nga tebateeseteese. Amangu ago okukuba mu ngalo okwo ne tukuwaayo ng'ekiweebwayo eky'okutendereza eri Mukama.

Nsuubira nti ekitabo kino kijja kuzuukusa abasumba n'ababudaabudi bangi eri obuvunaanyizibwa obunene bwe tulina okuleeta okutabagana n'okuwona mu nkolagana ezaayonooneka ne mu mmeeme ezaalumizibwa ebijjudde mu kkanisa zaffe. Era nsuubira nti abakkiriza bangi bajja kuyiga okukozesa ebisumuluzo ebiggulawo obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu eri ab'omukwano gwabwe, era ne beeta mu ddembe okuva mu biwundu bye beetisse okumala ebbanga eddene ennyo.

Ekiseera kituuse Setaani ateekebwe mu kifo kye, era abantu ba Katonda basobole okutambula nga balamu bulungi era nga balina amaanyi, mu kifo ky'okuwenyera nga bwe kiri eri bangi!

Eri abo abayinza okuba nga beetegedde nti balina ebiwundu nga basoma ekitabo kino, mmaliriza n'obulagirizi obumu obunaabasobozesa ‘okutambula mu kkubo’ ery'okuwona kwabwe. Bw'osobola okufuna omubudaabudi omulungi anaayita mu kino naawe, munno ng'oyo aba wa muwendo nnyo. Nandikukubirizza omusabe asome ekitabo kino nga temunnatandika.

Saba Mukama Aluŋŋamye Ebirowoozo Byo

Kakasa nti Mukama ayagala okuwonya ebiwundu by'emmeeme yo. Abimanyi, naye akuwadde ekisumuluzo eky'okuwona, era ayagala okikozese! Tajja kuddamu ssaala mu bitundu by'obulamu bwaffe mw'amaze okuwangulira ku musaalaba, era mw'atuwadde obuyinza n'obuvunaanyizibwa.

Twala Ekiseera Kyo

Okuwona tekutera kujja mangu. Ebisinga ku byafaayo bye nnyinza okwogera bikwata ku myezi mingi egy'okubudaabudibwa. Kitwala kiseera okuddamu okutambula ng'ofunye ekiwundu ekinene.

Nga bwe kyetaagisa okujjanjabibwa okw'ebinywa tusobole okuddamu okutambula oluvannyuma lw'akabenje akalumya amagulu, bwe kityo n'okujjanjabibwa okw'omwoyo kwetaagisa okutambula mu kkubo ery'okuwona kwaffe oluvannyuma lw'ebiwundu by'emmeeme ebimaze ebbanga ddene.

Yogera ku Byayita

Ntera okukubiriza oyo gwe mbudaabuda okwawula ebiseera bye ebyayita mu bitundu ebitono. Okugeza, nga tannatandika ssomero, mu ssomero lya pulayimale, mu myaka egy'obuvubuka, mu buto obw'okukula, n'ebirala. Mmubuuza ebibuuzo ebikwata ku maka ge, essomero, mikwano gye, ebintu by'ayagala n'ebyo by'akyawa, mu kiseera kye kimu nga nnoonyereza ku ngeri z'endowooza oba ez'obulumi. “Omwana omuto ali munda yo yawulira atya?”

Saba Mukama akwateko buli kiwundu nga bwe kibikkulwa.

Wandiika Buli Ky'olowooza nti Kikulu

Mbeera bulijjo n'ekkalaamu n'olupapula kumpi okuwandiikako engeri zonna eziyinza okuba nga zeeyoleka oba ebirowoozo byonna ebinzijira. Mu nnaku omubudaabudi oba mukwano gwo lw'ataba naawe, ojja kwewuunya ng'ebijjukizo eby'ebintu ebyerabiddwa edda bijja; naye lwaki weewuunya ate nga wasaba dda Mukama okwenyigira mu lugendo lwo olw'okuwona? Wandiika ebijjukizo bino.

Tegeera Obanga Walumizibwa Ekibi ky'Omulala

Tovunaana mulala ng'ekibi kikyo ggwe. Bw'oba nga wanyiiga, oteekwa okukikolako nga bwe kyannyonnyolwa mu ssuula ey'omwenda.

Togaana mazima ng'oyo eyakusobezza muntu gw'oyagala, era tomunoonyeza nsonga za kumwewolereza. Katonda amulaba ng'omwonoonyi, nga naffe bwe tuli — era abonoonyi boonoona! Tewali nsonga ya kuluggulugganya — kyogere nga bwe kiri — kibi! Ayinza okuba omwonoonyi eyanunulwa, naye akyasobola okukuleetera ekiwundu.

Emirundi mingi, ebiwundu byaleetebwawo awatali kugenderera, naye biwundu bya nnamaddala; era singa oyo eyakusobya teyali mwonoonyi, tebyandikulumizza bwe bityo.

Bwe nnatuuka okutegeera omusingi guno, ne ndaba engeri gye nayinza okuba nga nnalumya muwala wange nze kennyini olw'obutamanya.

Anne yali mu ddwaliro okumala wiiki ntonotono nga muwala waffe omubereberye, Corinne, tannazaalibwa; bw'atyo bwe yatandika okulumwa okuzaala, nze nnali eka nga simanyi kiribawo. Mikwano gyange ebiri be baasooka okumbuulira nti yali alumwa okuzaala, kubanga baali bakubidde essimu mu ddwaliro nga bagenda ku kiwummulo. Abasawo baabagamba nti omwana yali azaaliddwa, naye ne bagaana okwogera ebikwata ku kuzaala mu bujjuvu, naddala ekikula ky'omwana — kitaawe ye yali asaanidde okusooka okukimanya. Ne bankubiriza nnyo okukubira eddwaliro essimu balyoke bamanye ebikwata ku kuzaala nga tebannatandika kiwummulo kyabwe. Ne mbagamba nti nnandikikoze nga mmaze okusoma ekitabo kya Agatha Christie kye nnali nsoma! Mazima ddala nnali nsaaga, njagala kubaleka mu kwesunga; era amangu ago ne tugenda ffenna ku ssimu ey'olukale okuwulira amawulire ag'essanyu nti kaakano nnali kitaawe w'akaana akawala akalungi.

Kyokka olugero olwo lwaddibwamu emirundi mingi eri mikwano egyajjanga okutukyalira mu myaka egyaddirira, era oluusi nga muwala wange awo. Sirowoozangako ku ngeri gye yali awulira olugero olwo — nti taata yali tafaayo ku kiseera kye yazaalibwamu. Mpozzi teyali amwagala?

Nga wayise emyaka ebiri gyokka okuva lwe nnasooka okufulumya ekitabo kino, nnawandiikira Corinne nga mmusaba ansonyiwe olw'ebiwundu ebyaleetebwa obutalowooza bwange.

Wandiika Ebbaluwa, Ng'oyogera Butereevu ku Bulumi Bwo

Tekyetaagisa kulaga bbaluwa eno muntu yenna, wadde ng'oyinza okusalawo okugibuulira omubudaabudi wo. Naye kino kisaana kukolebwa oyo bw'aba nga wa kwesigibwa mu kukuuma ebyama, era ng'omanyi nti tajja kuleka bigambo byo kukyusa ndowooza ye ku ggwe oba ku oyo eyakulumya. Gezaako okuwandiika mu bujjuvu era nga tosaliriza, ng'owandiika bwe wawulira bwe walumizibwa: okugaanibwa, okunyoomebwa, okuswazibwa, n'ebirala.

Era gezaako okwongerako ebirungi byonna by'osobola okwogera.

Obutasaliriza kiyinza okuba ekizibu nnyo kubanga ebbaluwa eno esobola okuzuukusa enneewulira ez'amaanyi n'obulumi. Ekigendererwa kyayo kwe kukusobozesa okuleeta waggulu enneewulira ze wazikiriza okumala emyaka mingi.

Ebiwero eby'okusiba ebiwundu ebifuuse njegere biteekwa okuggibwako! Twala ekiseera kyo!

Salawo Okusonyiwa

Tegeera nti oyo eyakulumya mwonoonyi atambulira mu kizikiza. Muzibe w'amaaso ku ekyo ky'akoze emmeeme yo. Omulabe wo ow'amazima ye Setaani, ng'eggye lye libadde likugendererako okuva lwe wazaalibwa; ate oyo eyakusobya mubaka bubaka, atamanyi nkwe za Setaani. Sunguwalira Setaani, era osonyiwe omuzibe w'amaaso. Kakasa nti weetegese okusonyiwa buli kintu kye wawandiise mu bbaluwa yo.

Tosuubira Mukama kuwonya mu kifo mw'otoli mwetegefu kusonyiwa.

Salawo Okusumulula

Lwaki tokozesa ssaala ya Sitefano Omutukuvu? “Kitange, ebibi bino tobibabalira! Leero, nsalawo okubasumulula okuva mu musango gwonna.”

Bw'omala okusaba essaala eyo, nkuwa amagezi owandiike olunaku, ng'olukuuma mu bwongo bwo nga bw'okuuma olunaku olw'amazaalibwa.

Yokya Ebbaluwa!

Ensonga emaze okukolebwako — lwaki ogireka nga ekyawanikiddwa awo?

Luno lusaana kujjukirwa mu bwongo bwo ng'olunaku lwe watandikira okutambula mu kkubo ery'okuwona kwo — olunaku olw'okujaguza!

Sabira Oyo Eyakulumya

Weewaayo okusaba buli lunaku Katonda awe omukisa oyo eyakulumya. Abaana be bali wala ne Mukama? Basabire. Bizinensi ye eri mu buzibu? Sabira eyimuke. Bw'oyongera okusaba mu ngeri eno, Katonda ajja kukolera mu luguudo oluli wakati we nabo — oluguudo lwe waggulawo ng'oyita mu kusonyiwa n'okusumulula kwo. Bw'okola bw'otyo, ojja kuba weeggya mu buddu obw'enjegere ez'omutima ez'ebiwundu byo, era ofuuke omuweereza Yesu gwe yakuyita okuba.

Omuntu bw'akusobya n'atwala essaati yo, akufuula omuddu we; naye bw'omuleka n'ekkooti yo, weefuula omuweereza we. Bw'akusobya n'akuwaliriza okugenda kilomita emu, akufuula omuddu we; naye bw'omutwalirako n'eyokubiri, weefuula omuweereza we (Matayo 5:40-41). Bw'alumya emmeeme yo, ofuuka omuddu mu nneewulira zo; naye bw'omusabira, weefuula omuweereza we.

Okuyitibwa okusooka okw'obuyigirizwa kwe kufuuka omuweereza, nga Yesu bwe yakubeerera.

Beera Mwetegefu Okutabagana

Bwe wabaawo omukisa ogw'okutabagana n'oyo eyakulumya, toleka kutya wadde kweraliikirira kukuziyiza.

Ekikulu eri Mukama si kuwona kwokka, okukuwa omukisa, wabula n'okutabagana okumuwa Ye ekitiibwa!

Tambula mu Kkubo ery'Okuwona Kwo

Buli lunaku, weeteekeko ebyokulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda nga bwe biri mu Abaefeso 6:10-18. Kino kikole ng'okimanyi, era n'okwatula ng'okikola. “Neesiba olukoba olw'amazima, omuntu wange ow'omunda aleme okulumizibwa obulimba bw'omulabe. Neeteekako eky'omu kifuba eky'obutuukirivu, omulabe aleme okuleetera omutima gwange okwawukanamu mu kwewaayo n'okwagala Mukama,” n'ebirala. Abo bokka “abalina omutima omulongoofu” be “baliraba Katonda” — abo emitima gyabwe egitatabuddwamu bucaafu bwa nsi eno (Matayo 5:8).

Waayo Buli Kiwundu eri Omusawo Omukulu

Nga bwe kiri nti omulabe amanyi ebiwundu byo gye biri, ne Mukama abimanyi. Yawulira obulumi bwo bwe walumizibwa era ayaayaanira okuwona kwo; kyokka ekisumuluzo akikuwadde ggwe.

Bw'otandika okukikozesa, ali mwetegefu nnyo okukuyamba mu kutambula mu kkubo ery'okuwona. Nga bw'akubikkulidde ebiwundu, bw'atyo bw'aggyawo enjegere n'aleeta obulamu obutuukiridde mu kifo kyazo; kubanga mazima ye “Omusawo Omukulu,” omuwonya, “eyeetikka obuyinike bwaffe, n'atwala ennaku yaffe,” era “ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya” (Isaaya 53:4-5).

Eky'enkomerero, mwebaze olw'okuwona kwe!

Anne yali mu ddwaliro okumala wiiki ntonotono nga muwala waffe omubereberye, Corinne, tannazaalibwa; bw'atyo bwe yatandika okulumwa okuzaala, nze nnali eka nga simanyi kiribawo. Mikwano gyange ebiri be baasooka okumbuulira nti yali alumwa okuzaala, kubanga baali bakubidde essimu mu ddwaliro nga bagenda ku kiwummulo. Abasawo baabagamba nti omwana yali azaaliddwa, naye ne bagaana okwogera ebikwata ku kuzaala mu bujjuvu, naddala ekikula ky'omwana — kitaawe ye yali asaanidde okusooka okukimanya. Ne bankubiriza nnyo okukubira eddwaliro essimu balyoke bamanye ebikwata ku kuzaala nga tebannatandika kiwummulo kyabwe. Ne mbagamba nti nnandikikoze nga mmaze okusoma ekitabo kya Agatha Christie kye nnali nsoma! Mazima ddala nnali nsaaga, njagala kubaleka mu kwesunga; era amangu ago ne tugenda ffenna ku ssimu ey'olukale okuwulira amawulire ag'essanyu nti kaakano nnali kitaawe w'akaana akawala akalungi. Kyokka olugero olwo lwaddibwamu emirundi mingi eri mikwano egyajjanga okutukyalira mu myaka egyaddirira, era oluusi nga muwala wange awo. Sirowoozangako ku ngeri gye yali awulira olugero olwo — nti taata yali tafaayo ku kiseera kye yazaalibwamu. Mpozzi teyali amwagala? Nga wayise emyaka ebiri gyokka okuva lwe nnasooka okufulumya ekitabo kino, nnawandiikira Corinne nga mmusaba ansonyiwe olw'ebiwundu ebyaleetebwa obutalowooza bwange. Wandiika Ebbaluwa, Ng'oyogera Butereevu ku Bulumi Bwo Tekyetaagisa kulaga bbaluwa eno muntu yenna, wadde ng'oyinza okusalawo okugibuulira omubudaabudi wo. Naye kino kisaana kukolebwa oyo bw'aba nga wa kwesigibwa mu kukuuma ebyama, era ng'omanyi nti tajja kuleka bigambo byo kukyusa ndowooza ye ku ggwe oba ku oyo eyakulumya. Gezaako okuwandiika mu bujjuvu era nga tosaliriza, ng'owandiika bwe wawulira bwe walumizibwa: okugaanibwa, okunyoomebwa, okuswazibwa, n'ebirala. Era gezaako okwongerako ebirungi byonna by'osobola okwogera. Obutasaliriza kiyinza okuba ekizibu nnyo kubanga ebbaluwa eno esobola okuzuukusa enneewulira ez'amaanyi n'obulumi. Ekigendererwa kyayo kwe kukusobozesa okuleeta waggulu enneewulira ze wazikiriza okumala emyaka mingi. Ebiwero eby'okusiba ebiwundu ebifuuse njegere biteekwa okuggibwako! Twala ekiseera kyo! Salawo Okusonyiwa Tegeera nti oyo eyakulumya mwonoonyi atambulira mu kizikiza. Muzibe w'amaaso ku ekyo ky'akoze emmeeme yo. Omulabe wo ow'amazima ye Setaani, ng'eggye lye libadde likugendererako okuva lwe wazaalibwa; ate oyo eyakusobya mubaka bubaka, atamanyi nkwe za Setaani. Sunguwalira Setaani, era osonyiwe omuzibe w'amaaso. Kakasa nti weetegese okusonyiwa buli kintu kye wawandiise mu bbaluwa yo. Tosuubira Mukama kuwonya mu kifo mw'otoli mwetegefu kusonyiwa. Salawo Okusumulula Lwaki tokozesa ssaala ya Sitefano Omutukuvu? “Kitange, ebibi bino tobibabalira! Leero, nsalawo okubasumulula okuva mu musango gwonna.” Bw'omala okusaba essaala eyo, nkuwa amagezi owandiike olunaku, ng'olukuuma mu bwongo bwo nga bw'okuuma olunaku olw'amazaalibwa. Yokya Ebbaluwa! Ensonga emaze okukolebwako — lwaki ogireka nga ekyawanikiddwa awo? Luno lusaana kujjukirwa mu bwongo bwo ng'olunaku lwe watandikira okutambula mu kkubo ery'okuwona kwo — olunaku olw'okujaguza! Sabira Oyo Eyakulumya Weewaayo okusaba buli lunaku Katonda awe omukisa oyo eyakulumya. Abaana be bali wala ne Mukama? Basabire. Bizinensi ye eri mu buzibu? Sabira eyimuke. Bw'oyongera okusaba mu ngeri eno, Katonda ajja kukolera mu luguudo oluli wakati we nabo — oluguudo lwe waggulawo ng'oyita mu kusonyiwa n'okusumulula kwo. Bw'okola bw'otyo, ojja kuba weeggya mu buddu obw'enjegere ez'omutima ez'ebiwundu byo, era ofuuke omuweereza Yesu gwe yakuyita okuba. Omuntu bw'akusobya n'atwala essaati yo, akufuula omuddu we; naye bw'omuleka n'ekkooti yo, weefuula omuweereza we. Bw'akusobya n'akuwaliriza okugenda kilomita emu, akufuula omuddu we; naye bw'omutwalirako n'eyokubiri, weefuula omuweereza we (Matayo 5:40-41). Bw'alumya emmeeme yo, ofuuka omuddu mu nneewulira zo; naye bw'omusabira, weefuula omuweereza we. Okuyitibwa okusooka okw'obuyigirizwa kwe kufuuka omuweereza, nga Yesu bwe yakubeerera. Beera Mwetegefu Okutabagana Bwe wabaawo omukisa ogw'okutabagana n'oyo eyakulumya, toleka kutya wadde kweraliikirira kukuziyiza. Ekikulu eri Mukama si kuwona kwokka, okukuwa omukisa, wabula n'okutabagana okumuwa Ye ekitiibwa! Tambula mu Kkubo ery'Okuwona Kwo Buli lunaku, weeteekeko ebyokulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda nga bwe biri mu Abaefeso 6:10-18. Kino kikole ng'okimanyi, era n'okwatula ng'okikola. “Neesiba olukoba olw'amazima, omuntu wange ow'omunda aleme okulumizibwa obulimba bw'omulabe. Neeteekako eky'omu kifuba eky'obutuukirivu, omulabe aleme okuleetera omutima gwange okwawukanamu mu kwewaayo n'okwagala Mukama,” n'ebirala. Abo bokka “abalina omutima omulongoofu” be “baliraba Katonda” — abo emitima gyabwe egitatabuddwamu bucaafu bwa nsi eno (Matayo 5:8). Waayo Buli Kiwundu eri Omusawo Omukulu Nga bwe kiri nti omulabe amanyi ebiwundu byo gye biri, ne Mukama abimanyi. Yawulira obulumi bwo bwe walumizibwa era ayaayaanira okuwona kwo; kyokka ekisumuluzo akikuwadde ggwe. Bw'otandika okukikozesa, ali mwetegefu nnyo okukuyamba mu kutambula mu kkubo ery'okuwona. Nga bw'akubikkulidde ebiwundu, bw'atyo bw'aggyawo enjegere n'aleeta obulamu obutuukiridde mu kifo kyazo; kubanga mazima ye “Omusawo Omukulu,” omuwonya, “eyeetikka obuyinike bwaffe, n'atwala ennaku yaffe,” era “ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya” (Isaaya 53:4-5). Eky'enkomerero, mwebaze olw'okuwona kwe!
